notes.title: Director’s Letter Vol. 18
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/905f9245a21d5f7a0fde324fa6bfa8c0e6fc0e55.png[/img]
[b]Greetings, Rune Hunters.
I'm Seong Seop Song, the director of UNDECEMBER.[/b]

I'm writing to you as the season that began with the Star Guardian now comes to a close.

The long-awaited next season is titled [b]‘Abyss Gate’[/b].

Through the Chaos Statue, you will enter the Abyss Gate and descend into the dungeons where ever-stronger monsters await, proceeding all the way to the final depths.
I hope you reach the very end of the Abyss safely—and with that in mind, let me introduce you to the new season.

[h3][url=https://ud.floor.line.games/us/bbsCmn/detail/1755844453621021669][b][Go to Notice][/b][/url][/h3]

notes.title: Season [Starwalker] – June Partner Creator Announcement
notes.content:

notes.title: UNDECEMBER Account Linkage Guide (For Facebook-Only Users)
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

We would like to provide guidance regarding account usage for users who have been using Facebook as their sole login platform.

If you delete the linked app via the Facebook app or website,
your UNDECEMBER login information will also be deleted, and your Facebook-linked game account will become inaccessible.

Please note that if the Facebook link is removed in this manner,
you will no longer be able to access your game account via Facebook login.

To prevent any login issues,
we recommend that Facebook-only users link their account to one of the following platforms: Google, Apple, or FLOOR.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[h3][url=https://ud.floor.line.games/us/bbsCmn/detail/1744701014694006847][b][Go to Notice][/b][/url][/h3]

notes.title: Notice: Costume and Gear Summon Bonus Point Recovery
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters,

First and foremost, we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this issue has caused.

Earlier today, we resolved the issue where bonus points for Costume and Equipment Summon (Integrated) were reset through temporary maintenance.
However, while attempting to recover these points, an unexpected issue arose, preventing us from proceeding with the recovery and compensation process.

Our investigation into the cause of this problem took longer than expected, leading to extended inconvenience for many Rune Hunters.
Unfortunately, this meant we had to conclude the temporary maintenance without completing the recovery process, and we deeply regret the frustration this may have caused.

For those affected by the loss of bonus points from Costume and Equipment Summons (Integrated) after the Mar. 6 (Thu) maintenance,
we are actively working to verify and address the cause of today’s issue.
Our team is preparing to resume the recovery process as soon as possible to ensure everything is properly restored.
※ We will share an update on the recovery schedule in a separate announcement soon.

Once again, we truly appreciate your patience and understanding.
We deeply regret the inconvenience this has caused and remain committed to providing a smoother and more stable experience for all Rune Hunters.

Thank you for your support.

notes.content:

A new season of the Zodiac Pass,
where you can get various rewards and benefits through your journey with the new UNDECEMBER, has begun!

Enjoy your new adventures with the Zodiac Pass! 
Please see below for more details. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c428697b0f0c62b9c277439fdecc1caf219c6616.png[/img]

[b]◆ Season Trials of Power Zodiac Pass 2[/b]
  A new Zodiac Pass is beginning!

[b]■ Zodiac Pass 2 Period [/b]
- After the Feb. 6 (Thu) maintenance - Until before the Mar. 6 (Thu) maintenance (UTC+9)

[b]■ What is the Zodiac Pass?[/b]
- By clearing Zodiac Pass missions, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass level. You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
- Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 25, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
- You can purchase the Zodiac Pass in either Standard Mode or Season Mode from your account.
- For Zodiac Passes that are purchased in Season Mode, Pass missions, Rewards, and levels will be shared with all Season difficulty modes.
 └ E.g. Playing in Standard Mode will not affect the Season Mode Pass.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9989b16ee72441cebb4e59a2f442bc77ca530a8c.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Missions[/b]
 - You can check missions through the ‘Event’ icon in the game.
 - There are both Daily Missions and Season Missions.
 - Season Missions can only be cleared once during the Zodiac Pass period, and more Pass EXP can be obtained through them.
 - During the Zodiac Pass period, 5 Daily Missions will be given every day, and you can obtain Pass EXP by clearing them.
 - Daily Missions will be refreshed every day at 09:00 (UTC+9).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9af5c1a95f6bb6d435d632218471811cd42f0d8c.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Rewards[/b]
 - Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
 - Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass Level increases.

[b][Standard][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/f2b81046f97fb326935541d5c9743072afca037b.png[/img]

[b][Season Mode][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/f2e9bf3faf03c322ddfc0a3c13b3bc82528658bf.png[/img]

[b]■ Premium Pass Information[/b]
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, you can receive Premium Rewards
 in addition to Normal Rewards when your Pass Level increases.
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, special benefits will be applied during the Pass period.
● Alchemy Slot +1
● Alchemy Acceleration +50%
● Stardust of Oblivion (Zodiac free reset)
※ Premium Pass benefits are only granted to the mode in which you purchase the Pass (Standard/Season).
 - 1,180 Diamonds are required to activate the Premium Pass.
 - Your purchased Premium Pass and its benefits will only be valid during the Zodiac Pass 2 period.

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ The Zodiac Pass period and details may be subject to change.
※ Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are applied separately for Standard and Season Mode (but they are not separated for the difficulty modes within Season Mode).
※ [Exclusive] items and items obtained from [Exclusive] chests are untradeable.
※ Trials of Power Summon Ticket obtained from Gear Summon Ticket Selection Chests will be removed after the scheduled maintenance for the next season.
※ Lacrima that can be obtained from [Exclusive] Legendary Lacrima Random Chest does not receive bonus absorb rate.
※ You must purchase the Premium Pass in either Standard or Season Mode to purchase Premium Pass Rewards.
※ Premium Pass benefits are only applied to the Standard or Season Mode in which you purchase the pass. (E.g. If you purchase the Premium Pass in Season Mode, its benefits will only affect Season Characters)
※ You can see the contents of Chest items through View Info (i) button in the item’s tooltip in the game.
※ For more information on chances for chance-type items, please check the Notice of our official website.
※ Once the Zodiac Pass period ends, your level, activated benefits, and points will be reset and rewards changed.
※ If you have any activated level rewards, please claim them before the end of the period (before the Mar. 6 (Thu) 2025 maintenance).
※ The refund guidelines and terms of service are available within the game and FLOOR.
※ For inquiries about the product, please contact FLOOR Support.
※ These products may be resold in the same or similar format in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Use the Zodiac Pass and add extra fun to your new journey! 

Thank you.

notes.title: Beginner's Guide Event #2 🎉
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters!

We’re excited to introduce Beginner's Guide Event #2, a chance to support new players by creating detailed guides to help them overcome entry barriers and excel in their journey through UNDECEMBER. Plus, you can earn fantastic rewards based on feedback and community engagement!

📚 Event Topics
Select one of the following topics to focus your guide on:
1️⃣ Quick Level 100 Progression Guide
2️⃣ Starter Build Recommendations and Setup Guide
3️⃣ Chaos Dungeon Beginner’s Guide
4️⃣ Gear Enchant Beginner’s Guide

Upload your text-based guide to the ⁠[url=https://discord.com/channels/831435944887975936/1301432663961243668]📖beginners-guide channel[/url] in Discord, ensuring it is helpful and easy for new players to follow. Including screenshots or videos in your guide will provide additional clarity and earn extra consideration during the review process.

Community feedback and reactions will influence the selection process. One top guide per topic will be selected, with the most outstanding guide receiving a special bonus prize!

🎁 Event Rewards
🏆 Top Winner (1):
Zodiac Sprinter (3 days) x10
1,500 Rubies

✨ Runner-ups (3):
Zodiac Sprinter (3 days) x10

📅 Event Duration
January 24 – February 16

⚠️ Important Notes
※ Guides must be written in a beginner-friendly format.
※ Submissions with embedded YouTube links will receive bonus points.
※ Please avoid changing your in-game or community ID during the event period, as it may affect reward eligibility.
※ Submissions should be original, relevant to the event topics, and thoughtfully written to qualify for selection.

We’re looking forward to seeing your creative and informative guides! Your contributions will not only enrich the community but also inspire and support new Rune Hunters as they embark on their journey.

Thank you for your dedication to UNDECEMBER, and best of luck to all participants!

■ Event Period

■ Event Details
- You can obtain 'Ashes' by chance upon defeating monsters in the Chaos Dungeon stages.
※ You can obtain Ashes only in Tier 1 - 10 Chaos Dungeon stages of Normal, Magic, Rare, and Legendary Grades.
※ You cannot obtain Ashes from Unique Chaos Card, Traces of Memory, or Exodium or Greater Chaos Card.
- You can convert a Chaos Card to a 'Ash-covered Chaos Card' using Ashes obtained from 'Fireplace' at Saluto.
※ Only Tier 1 - 10 Chaos Cards of Normal, Magic, Rare, and Legendary Grades can be converted to Ash-covered Chaos Cards.
※ You can upgrade the grade of an Ash-covered Chaos Card by using additional Ashes.
- You can register an Ash-covered Chaos Card to activate the event with a guaranteed chance.
- When the event occurs, 3 'Ash-covered Souls' following your character will be created, and each Soul gives the player and monsters buffs.
※ You can check the appearing Ash-covered Souls and their buffs while converting a card at the Fireplace.
- Ash-covered Souls repose if you interact with objects in the dungeon, 'skeletal corpse' or 'Gravestone', and the buffs given by the souls will be removed.
- If you successfully put an Ash-covered Soul to rest, you can obtain 'Developer’s Soul Dust'.
- You can use the obtained Developer’s Soul Dusts to purchase diverse rewards from the 'Event Shop' run by an NPC, Peve, at Town and Saluto.

notes.title: UNDECEMBER Season Trials of Power Zodiac Pass 1
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

A new season of the Zodiac Pass,
where you can get various rewards and benefits through your journey with the new UNDECEMBER, has begun!

Enjoy your new adventures with the Zodiac Pass! 
Please see below for more details. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c428697b0f0c62b9c277439fdecc1caf219c6616.png[/img]

[b]◆ Season Trials of Power Zodiac Pass 1[/b]
  A new Zodiac Pass is beginning!

[b]■ Zodiac Pass 1 Period[/b]
 - After the Jan. 9 (Thu) maintenance – Before the Feb. 6 (Thu) maintenance (UTC+9)

[b]■ What is the Zodiac Pass?[/b]
 - By clearing Zodiac Pass missions, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
  You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
 - Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 25, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
- You can purchase the Zodiac Pass with your account from Standard or Season Mode.
- If you purchase the Zodiac Pass in Season Mode, its missions, rewards, and levels will be shared across all the difficulty modes within Season Mode.
  └ E.g.) Your play in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c4dae433de511b18e0dd475d76ab52ac3801aceb.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Missions[/b]
 - You can check missions through the ‘Event’ icon in the game.
 - There are both Daily Missions and Season Missions.
 - Season Missions can only be cleared once during the Zodiac Pass period, and more Pass EXP can be obtained through them.
 - During the Zodiac Pass period, 5 Daily Missions will be given every day, and you can obtain Pass EXP by clearing them.
 - Daily Missions will be refreshed every day at 09:00 (UTC+9).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9af5c1a95f6bb6d435d632218471811cd42f0d8c.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Rewards[/b]
 - Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
 - Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass Level increases.

[b][Standard][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/ace7cbd1363f239b90e31c1d96d33f9020014bab.png[/img]

[b][Season Mode][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/d440463fb413d4e9aa92346e6ab6bcca9c77ac25.png[/img]

[b]■ Premium Pass Information[/b]
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, you can receive Premium Rewards
 in addition to Normal Rewards when your Pass Level increases.
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, special benefits will be applied during the Pass period.
● Alchemy Slot +1
● Alchemy Acceleration +50%
● Stardust of Oblivion (Zodiac free reset)
※ Premium Pass benefits are only granted to the mode in which you purchase the Pass (Standard/Season).
 - 1,180 Diamonds are required to activate the Premium Pass.
 - Your purchased Premium Pass and its benefits will only be valid during the Zodiac Pass 1 period.

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ The Zodiac Pass period and details may be subject to change.
※ Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are applied separately for Standard and Season Mode (but they are not separated for the difficulty modes within Season Mode).
※ You must purchase the Premium Pass in either Standard or Season Mode to claim Premium Pass Rewards.
※ Premium Pass benefits are only applied to the Standard or Season Mode in which you purchase the pass.
(E.g. If you purchase the Premium Pass in Season Mode, its benefits will only affect Season Characters)
※ You can see the contents of Chest items through ‘🍳View Info’ in the item’s tooltip in the game.
※ To see chance information for chance-based items, please check this Notice on the official website.
※ Once the Zodiac Pass period ends, your level, activated benefits, and points will be reset and rewards changed.
※ If you have any activated level rewards,
  please claim them before the end of the period (before the 2025 Feb. 6 (Thu) maintenance).
※ For inquiries about the product, please contact FLOOR Support.
※ These products may be resold in a same or similar format in the future.
※ 'Purchase Previous Pass' is not included in the Season Missions of the first Zodiac Passes of each season. 
    Please take this into consideration when purchasing the last Zodiac Passes for each season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Use the Zodiac Pass and add extra fun to your new journey! 

Thank you.

notes.title: Advance Notice on Upcoming Changes with Jan. 9 Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

There will be various changes coming into effect with the new update that is taking place on Jan. 9 (Thu).

Among these changes, we would like to inform you in advance of the content that will be reset, information regarding the end of Season Re:Birth,
as well as content adjustments that will take place in preparation for the Season 'Trials of Power' update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

◈ Auction House Suspension Measures

◆ Auction House Suspension Measures
After Jan. 6 (Mon) 2024, 11:00 (UTC+9), you will no longer be able to register new items at the Trading Post and Auction House and will not be able to bid on items that have been registered at the Auction House.
Items that have been registered before the patch will remain registered in the Auction House for their remaining time and can be purchased through buyout.

◈ Content Reset

◆ Season Mode Chaos Statue Information
Through the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, the Chaos Compendium Score and Statue Level in the Season mode will be integrated to the higher one between the Season mode and Standard Mode.
※ The Chaos Statue of the Standard Mode will not be reset.
※ Even after the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, Chaos Cards, Traces of Memory, Exodium Cards, and Chaos Key and chests containing them will remain.


◆ Chaos Rune and Chaos Ring Reset
With the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, your Chaos Rune and Chaos Ring of the Chaos Statue will be reset.
※ Upon reset, equipment information of Chaos Rune Cast, Chaos Runes owned in Storage and Bag, and Chest items containing Chaos Runes will be deleted.

If you have any unclaimed rewards saved in the Chaos Ring, please claim them before the maintenance.


◆ Black Market Reset
With the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, the Black Market's Friendship level, item list, saved items, and Pirate's Coins will be reset.

The Pirate's Coins and Pirate's Coin Chests that you own will be deleted with the update.

Your saved items on the Black Market will be deleted after the update, so please purchase them before the Season Trials of Power maintenance.


◆ Relic and Zodiac Reset
After the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, your Relics and Zodiacs will be reset.

Your Relic Level and EXP, and any Light of Life that you own, 
will be combined based on whichever values are higher out of Season/Standard mode.  

All Avatar information will be reset and Divinity Points will be given depending on your combined Relic Level.

Please log in after the update to activate your character's Relic Avatar and reassign your Divinity Points, 
as well as your Zodiac Traits and Stat Points.


◆ Constellation of Time Reset
After the Jan. 8 (Thu) update, your Constellation of Time stage and your Powerful Emotions will be reset.

Please ensure that you complete any Constellation of Time stages you are playing before the update.


◆ Zodiac Stone Emotion Engraving Reset
After the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, your Emotion Engravings on Zodiac Stones will be reset.

You can perform Emotion Engraving again through Constellation of Time after the update.


◆ Solo Descent Raids Reset
After the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, your Solo Descent Raids information will be reset.

Please ensure that you complete any Raid you are playing before the update.


◆ Mastery Reset
After the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, your Mastery will be reset.

Your Mastery Level will be combined based on whichever level is higher out of Season/Standard mode.
Please log in after the update to reassign your reset Mastery Points.


◆ Rune Master Points Reset
After the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, Rune Master Points consumed for The Path of the Rune Master, unlocking Skill Slots, etc., will be reset.

Please log in after the update to reassign your reset Rune Master Points.


◆ Offering System Reset
After the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, your Offering Mission progress and used Offering Points will be reset.

Offering Points from the previous season will be added up and will be able to be used in the new season.
※ Offering Points obtained during the Season Re:Birth remains until the Season Trials of Power.


◆ God's Blessing / Character Traits Reset
After the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, your God's Blessing and Character Traits will be reset.

Please log in after the update to reassign your reset God's Blessing and Character Traits.

◈ Balance and Content Adjustments

◆ Changes to Skill & Link Rune Effects
With the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, certain Runes' effects will be changed.


◆ Balance Adjustments to Skill & Link Runes
- With the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, the balance for certain Runes will be adjusted.


◆ Improvements to Zodiac Nodes
- The effect of the 'Acid Manipulator' Specialization Zodiac will be improved.
- A new effect of the 'Enlargement' Specialization Zodiac will be improved.
- Certain effects of the Specialization Zodiac Cosmos Node will be improved.
- Steel, Sadness, Torch, and Tipan Specialization Zodiacs will be changed.
- Hammer, Wrath, Bonfire, and Flame Specialization Zodiacs will be changed.
- Darkness, Stra, Fisherman, and Sailboat Specialization Zodiacs will be changed.
- Brilliance, Vacuum, Waterfall, and Pirate Specialization Zodiacs will be changed.
- Dawn, Hail, Monsoon, and Sympathy Specialization Zodiacs will be changed.
- Respiration, Corpse, Wisp, and Executioner Specialization Zodiacs will be changed.


◆ Improvements to Gear Options
Through the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, elements of certain Legendary and Ancient options that do not fit their concepts will be adjusted.


◆ Change of Item Stacks
The maximum stacks of certain consumable items will be adjusted.


◆ Improvement of Stat Calculation
The formula of the Movement Speed stat will be improved.


◆ Change of the Rule for Solo Descent Raids Honorable Statue Registration
With the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, the rule for Solo Descent Raids Honorable Statue registration will be changed.

◈ Information on the End of Re:Birth

◆ Season Mode Items That Will Be Moved to Standard Mode at the End of Season Re:Birth
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/fff6602b3aa635dcd25a96910b848885ce021512.png[/img]

◆ Items That Will Be Moved to Temporary Storage at the End of Season Re:Birth
- The items in your Season Character's Storage will be moved to Temporary Storage.
- The items registered in your Season Character's Unique/Rune Compendium will be moved to Temporary Storage.

notes.title: Director’s Letter Vol. 16
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.
I'm Seong Seop Song, the director of UNDECEMBER.

We are already halfway through the Season Re:Birth since it is a short-term season.

I would like to start this Director’s Letter by saying that we look forward to your continuous support for UNDECEMBER at the end of this year as well.

As many of you already know, there was a Q&A session with two YouTube streamers,
where we received many honest opinions about the game, from the suggestions for game improvements and some tough questions that were harder to answer.

To address those questions, we would like to give you an insight into the direction of development through this Director’s Letter.


1. Season System

The most common feedback we’ve received concerns the future of the season system, and we understand there have been a lot of concerns around it.
To give you a direct answer, UNDECEMBER will be reinforcing the season system from now on.
We will implement growth support buffs that are at or above the level of those applied in the Season Re:Birth so that new and returning Rune Hunters can easily adapt to the game, 
and make several changes including increasing drop rates, decreasing the amount of consumed currencies, and holding various events to make sure that more Rune Hunters can enjoy the endgame content during each season.
The changes will also include setting the chance of the newly added season content to occur at 100%, and applying discounts on Chaos Stone costs to play the content of previous seasons.
Lastly, we will change the reset rule of the Chaos Statue so that players of Standard Mode do not have to go through the inconvenience of raising the Statue Level again.

2. Drop Rate

Next, we heard a lot of thoughts on the low drop chances.
While low drop rates bore the gameplay by making players lose hopes of obtaining desired items,
frequent drops of items that are designed to be rare can diminish their value.
We have been working on a solution to address both of these problems at the same time, and we will make improvements as below.

Simply increasing the drop rates can only be noticeable by Rune Hunters at higher stages who have access to certain content,
so we will avoid directly increasing relatively lower drop rates but diversify the sources of these items.

In addition, we will significantly reduce the prices in the Disassemble Shop, allowing all Rune Hunters to obtain reasonable rewards that are in line with their playtime,
and rebalance the drop system so that certain Gear and Essences, which were previously dropped from higher difficulty content, will also be dropped from the lower difficulty content.

Moreover, we plan to hold more events for Rune Hunters, such as the Holiday Raid Event, to provide additional opportunities for obtaining more items,
so that more Rune Hunters can experience the fun of obtaining better loot.

3. Balance Changes

UNDECEMBER’s skill balance patches are not intended to only lower stats,
but rather to first adjust skills that are rarely used to make as various skills as possible used,
and only to lower the stats of skills that harm the overall game balance due to its overpowering stats.

Of course, we are aware that the ideal solution is to avoid making a skill that harms the balances in the first place, and the development team will review the balance more thoroughly to do so.

4. Content Improvements

Many of you expressed concerns regarding the content that was introduced to refresh the game but has now lost its appeal.
We will make improvements to content according to the order of priority as stated below.

1) Improvements to the Constellation of Time

We heard many complaints regarding the Constellation of Time, even that it needs to be removed from the game.
The development team has considered several options from revamping the content to removing it, but has concluded that it cannot be removed since there are several related content.
Therefore, we have concluded instead that we will increase the Emotion and Gold drops drastically so that it has more fruits to play the Constellation of Time.
We will make sure that old content is not neglected in the future.

2) Improvements to the Solo Raids
Solo Raid is a content that has been avoided by the players due to its discouraging rewards and difficulty unlike its designed intention.
In the next season, we will increase the rewards and lower the boss difficulty.
Plus, to fill the empty statues in Saluto, we will make the change to the statue registration from the previous way to register the first users for each statue to a new way that the users are registered in the order of defeats.

3) Improvements to Bottomless Abyss Monsters

We have received much feedback that Bottomless Abyss monsters are a great barrier when you encounter them without sufficient growth.
We will lower the number and HP of Bottomless Abyss monsters in the next season to lower the barrier for new Rune Hunters.

5. Convenience Improvements

The development team agrees that the game’s convenience needs to be improved..
To answer the requests from many of you, We will add a feature to save selected information of Chaos Stone in the next season.
Other than that, we will add a function to display all descriptions of Zodiac Nodes, and a ‘Withdraw All’ feature in Compendium.
We will continue to make more improvements to other elements that we were unable to address 
this time.

While we have been giving extensive consideration to the game content internally, the way we have communicated with you may have not been the most effective.
Moving forward, we will try to share more details on the future of the development through various ways.

About the Next Season

We hope we’ve answered some of your questions about the direction of development. Below, we’ll share details about the next season.

1. Scenario Addition
The player and Canna arrive in Nemera’s city Ghieva, looking for the Zodiac Master.
To meet the mayor ‘Hatus,’ known as the Zodiac Master, you two enter the Arena together.
At the Arena, a boy trying to steal a participation ticket and a mysterious man named ‘Oppert’ appear and the truth behind the stories starts to reveal.
Please check the story of Arena out yourself in the game that opens the first half of the Act 14.

2. Season Content: Arena
You can enter the Arena by collecting Essence dropped in the Chaos Dungeon.
You can obtain growth gear by defeating the bosses that appear consecutively in the Arena.
The obtained gear can be added to the extended Gear Slot, and will summon the soul of the boss monster (provisional name) by chance to support your attacks.

3. Zodiac Specialization Node Renewal
Zodiac Specialization Nodes will be drastically improved in the next season.
We are currently working on original nodes for Special Nodes to provide the Rune Hunters with a different kind of fun that was not experienced before.
To mention one of them, Bowguns that have been ignored so far will receive Specialization Nodes.
We look forward to your creative builds combining new nodes.

4. Tier 10 Charm and the New Charm Essence
Charm will be extended to Tier 10 from 9.
In addition, a new Essence to regrant the Options to a desired Charm will be released, and this will partially help lower the difficulty of setting Charms.


To conclude,

we understand that Rune Hunters want a changed game, not the game getting ready to be changed,
and we are committed to working hard so that you can feel the changes in the future.

We will continue to put our best effort into running the remaining Season Re:Birth and preparing for the next season.
We look forward to your support and anticipation.

Thank you.

[b]◆ Season Re:Birth Zodiac Pass 2[/b]
  A new Zodiac Pass is beginning!

[b]■ Zodiac Pass 2 Period[/b]
 - After the Dec. 5 (Thu) maintenance – Before the Jan. 9 (Thu) maintenance (UTC+9)

[b]■ What is the Zodiac Pass?[/b]
 - By clearing Zodiac Pass missions, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
  You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
 - Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 25, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
- You can purchase the Zodiac Pass with your account from Standard or Season Mode.
- If you purchase the Zodiac Pass in Season Mode, its missions, rewards, and levels will be shared across all the difficulty modes within Season Mode.
  └ E.g.) Your play in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/bf6149e307a3c15aa0904d3feeb557f3cc0c002f.png[/img]

 - You can check missions through the ‘Event’ icon in the game.

 - Season Missions can only be cleared once during the Zodiac Pass period, and more Pass EXP can be obtained through them.
 - During the Zodiac Pass period, 5 Daily Missions will be given every day, and you can obtain Pass EXP by clearing them.
 - Daily Missions will be refreshed every day at 09:00 (UTC+9).

 - Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass Level increases.

[b][Standard][/b]

[b][Season Mode][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/be3a91b09ee64cbad1123af1c69a87c748b3affa.png[/img]

 in addition to Normal Rewards when your Pass Level increases.

notes.title: Director’s Letter Vol. 15
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

I'm Seong Seop Song, the director of UNDECEMBER.

We would like to inform you more about the drop balance adjustments.

We are aware of the current situation where many of Rune Hunters are expressing opinions regarding Essence,
and we believe this is caused mainly because of the drop balance adjustments made in the Nov. 7 update.

Even though we tried to inform you about the drop balance adjustments in the previous Director's Letter before the update,
we felt the need to provide a more detailed explanation on the balance adjustments since it is core game content that is important for all users.

In the previous season 5, an issue occurred where much more Divine and Ancient Essence were dropped than our intention,
and while we first concluded that we adjust the drop chance as soon as possible, we have not changed the rate during the season 5 to avoid any confusion that such mid-season change may bring about, 
since the Divine and Ancient Essence were first introduced in season 5. 
However, our initial understanding maintained that the unintended drop balance was going to harm the stable service in the future,
and thus we have adjusted the drop chances of Tickets and amount of drops based on the Hard Mode difficulty in the Season Re:Birth update,
which led to confusion among Rune Hunters due to insufficient notice in advance. 

Besides, we have been introducing new content with a higher chance of occurrence while lowering the chance of occurrence of the content introduced in other seasons after the season's end.

For example, the 'Ancient Being Purification' event which occurred throughout the previous season became a randomly occurring event in Season Re:Birth.
We feel that we have not informed you enough about how the season content is operated,
and that the amount of obtained items provided from the content will decrease as the chance of the content occurring lowers.

For the Chaos Statue, we have implemented a feature to definitely activate the previous season's content,
the process of manual activation may feel cumbersome to Rune Hunters, leading to feeling much less likely to play the seasonal events.
We would like to also mention that the convenience improvement for this feature will be made in future seasons.

As we explain more details about the drop balance adjustments, we understand that Rune Hunters may feel greater difference in the adjusted drop rates,
we will work on a variety of ways to provide them in the game.

Additionally, since we have heard a lot of voices regarding the price of Divine and Ancient Essence in Disassemble Shop,
we are working to prepare an adjustment for it in the next season, which will lower the prices of items including Divine and Ancient Essence.

We will make sure to provide detailed information regarding significant updates and patches in the future.

Thank you.

UNDECEMBER's Season Re:Birth is finally here!

Play the game with the Rune Hunter Growth Pass to get various rewards as you grow!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

◆ Rune Hunter Growth Pass
The Rune Hunter Growth Pass, a product that gives you rewards every time your character levels up, will be released.
　
■ Rune Hunter Growth Pass Period
- After the Nov. 7 (Thu) maintenance - Until before the next Season update
　
■ What is the Rune Hunter Growth Pass?
- Level up your character to certain levels to obtain various rewards that correspond to each level.
- Rune Hunter Growth Pass rewards start from Lv. 5 and go up to Lv. 100, increasing by increments of 5 levels.
- You can purchase the Rune Hunter Growth Pass once per mode, and your Pass progress will only apply to the mode in which the Pass has been purchased.
 └ E.g. Playing in Season Normal Mode will not affect your Pass in Season Hardcore Mode.
　
■ Rune Hunter Growth Pass Rewards
- Normal Rewards: Obtain by reaching the required character levels.
- Premium Rewards: Obtain by purchasing the Premium Pass and reaching the required character levels.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/6e5536b17c38c0dc89ccbecf33a9843fa4c7a612.png[/img]

- When you purchase the Rune Hunter Growth Premium Pass and reach the required Pass levels, you can obtain Premium Rewards as well as Normal Rewards.
- With Premium Rewards, you can claim Rewards that are of higher value.
- Purchased Premium Passes will only be active during the current Pass period, so please ensure that you claim your rewards before the Pass period ends.
　
■ To Note
※ The period and details outlined above may be subject to change.
※ Please ensure that you obtain any activated level rewards before the Pass period ends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Experience more exciting journeys with the Rune Hunter Growth Pass!
　
Thank you.

notes.title: Advance Notice on Upcoming Changes with Nov. 7 Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.
 
There will be various changes coming into effect with the new season update that is taking place on Nov. 7 (Thu).
 
Among these changes, we would like to inform you in advance of the content that will be reset, information regarding the end of Season 5, as well as certain content adjustments that will take place in preparation for the Season Re:Birth update.
 
※ The information may change when the update takes place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

◈ Auction House Measures

◆ Auction House Suspension Measures
After Nov. 4 (Mon) 2024, 11:00 (UTC+9), you will no longer be able to register new items at the Trading Post and Auction House and will not be able to bid on items that have been registered at the Auction House.
Items that have been registered before the patch will remain registered in the Auction House for their remaining time and can be purchased through buyout.

◈ Content Reset

◆ Chaos Statue Reset and Current Chaos Cards
Your Chaos Statue and Chaos Card will not be reset during the Nov. 7 (Thu) Season Re:Birth update and will remain as they are.
※ Chaos Statue Level will be recorded on whichever level is higher out of Season/Standard mode.

◆ Chaos Rune and Chaos Ring Reset (Added on Nov. 1 12:05 (UTC+9))
With the Nov. 7 (Thu) update, your Chaos Rune and Chaos Ring of the Chaos Statue will be reset.

If you have any unclaimed rewards saved in the Chaos Ring, please claim them before the maintenance.

◆ Black Market Reset
With the Nov. 7 (Thu) update, the Black Market’s Friendship level, item list, saved items, and Pirate’s Coins will be reset.
 
The Pirate's Coins and Pirate's Coin Chests that you own will be deleted with the update.
Please use all the Pirate's Coins and Pirate's Coin Chests you own before the update takes place. 
 
Your saved items on the Black Market will be deleted after the update, so please purchase them before the Season Re:Birth maintenance.

◆ Relic and Zodiac Reset
After the Nov. 7 (Thu) update, your Relics and Zodiacs will be reset.
 
Your Relic Level and EXP, and any Light of Life that you own, will be combined based on whichever values are higher out of Season/Standard mode.  

All Avatar information will be reset and Divinity Points will be given depending on your combined Relic Level.
 
Please log in after the update to activate your character’s Relic Avatar and reassign your Divinity Points, as well as your Zodiac Traits and Stat Points.

◆ Constellation of Time Reset
After the Nov. 7 (Thu) update, your Constellation of Time stage and your Powerful Emotions will be reset.
Please ensure that you complete any Constellation of Time stages you are playing before the update.

◆ Zodiac Stone Emotion Engraving Reset
After the Nov. 7 (Thu) update, your Emotion Engravings on Zodiac Stones will be reset.
You can perform Emotion Engraving again through Constellation of Time after the update.

◆ Mastery Reset 
After the Nov. 7 (Thu) update, your Mastery will be reset.
  
Your Mastery Level will be combined based on whichever level is higher out of Season/Standard mode.
Please log in after the update to reassign your reset Mastery Points.

◆ Rune Master Points Reset
After the Nov. 7 (Thu) update, Rune Master Points consumed for The Path of the Rune Master, unlocking Skill Slots, etc., will be reset.
Please log in after the update to reassign your reset Rune Master Points.

◈ Balance and Content Adjustments

◆ Changes to Skill & Link Rune Effects
With the Nov. 7 (Thu) update, certain Runes' effects will be changed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/726e67ba8c640d4c61905d3bf9e8c57b462eab6b.png[/img]

◆ Balance Adjustments to Skill & Link Runes
With the Nov. 7 (Thu) update, the balance for certain Runes will be adjusted.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9f1897e0d64d5849fc7564b84daa48e7c6260bfd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/b002171aa0e0a91f186f0d96ea164a66c0bcc1ea.png[/img]

◆ Adjustments to Skill Rune Awakening
With the Nov. 7 (Thu) update, the balance of some Skill Runes' Awakenings will be adjusted.
Affected Runes that are Awakened will be reverted to the state they were before being Awakened after the update, and '[Exclusive] Skill Rune Engraving Stone' will be given.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9b1c7e7f6cee4fcc2da7cefbc93b7ab237df5d1a.png[/img]

◆ Improvement to Energy Effects
With the Nov. 7 (Thu) update, Energy Effects will be improved.

◆ Removal of Return Scroll Item
Return Scroll items you own will be deleted after the Nov. 7 (Thu) update.
Returning will be free after the update and no longer require the Return Scroll. The cooldown will be 3 seconds.

◈ Information on the End of Season 5

◆ Season Mode Items That Will Be Moved to Standard Mode at the End of Season 5
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/2f90faa461a3d6c6483807208cf744dd63ba6739.png[/img]

◆ Items That Will Be Moved to Temporary Storage at the End of Season 5
- The items in your Season Character’s Storage will be moved to Temporary Storage.
- The items registered in your Season Character’s Unique/Rune Compendium will be moved to Temporary Storage.
- The items in your Season Character’s Alchemy Slots will be moved to the Temporary Slots per mode.
- The items in your Season Character’s Mailbox will be moved to the Temporary Slots per mode.

※ To Note 
✔ We will not be able to offer you any assistance in restoring any Black Market items that you do not claim before the Nov. 7 (Thu) maintenance.
✔ Items moved to Temporary Storage and Temporary Slots during the previous season will be deleted if not claimed before the start of Season Re:Birth.
✔ We will not be able to offer you any assistance for Temporary Storage and Temporary Slot items from previous seasons that have been deleted once the new season begins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

※ The information may change when the update takes place.
 
We hope that the information above will help you avoid any inconvenience as you play the game.
We hope you are looking forward to the new update and Season Re:Birth.
 
Thank you.

notes.title: Director’s Letter Vol. 14
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Rune Hunters.[/b]
Nice to meet you. This is 'Seong Seop Song', the new director of UNDECEMBER, taking over from the former director, Sang Kwon Han.

It is both a great honor and responsibility to answer to your expectations.
I promise our team and I will present you with a better service to fulfill your anticipation.

Since the Season 5 'Exodium' update, UNDECEMBER’s development team has been working on the content for the upcoming third anniversary and the next season.
As we prepared for the third anniversary, the update’s scale became massive in proportion to the event’s gravity.
Also, the necessity to review what we have been preparing for the long-term service of UNDECEMBER has arisen.
So, the new season, 'Re:Birth', will be the first exhibition of the upcoming changes of UNDECEMBER.


[b]■ Season 'Re:Birth'[/b]

Starting from this season, each season will be given a unique name to hint at the season’s concept more intuitively, instead of the current numbering system.
The new season is called Re:Birth, which implies the revival of the 13th god of UNDECEMBER, Serpens the Evil God, in a more powerful state, and the rebirth of UNDECEMBER into a new shape for the upcoming third anniversary.
Also, the Re:Birth mode I will mention hereafter will be the key element of the season.

[b]1. Re:Birth Mode[/b]

Re:Birth Mode, which will be added in the upcoming season, is a new mode that takes the best of the previous mode, Origin, and remedies its shortcomings.
Although Origin Mode has provided Rune Hunters with the fun of farming through chances of obtaining gears with all options (even the legendary ones) without having to enchant, it had a clear downside that you relied solely on random chances to obtain the desired option.

In the new Re:Birth Mode, every Gear is dropped with every option granted.
After you clear all the episodes, you will become able to use different Enchants as you can in the base mode.

You will be able to enjoy the fun of farming you can only find in the Hack-and-Slash genre while exploring through episodes.
Later, diverse Enchants to allow Rune Hunters to design the build they want will become available.
The goal of Re:Birth Mode is to provide you with these different kinds of fun throughout your gaming experience.

[b]2. Re:Birth Mode Exclusive Content and Events[/b]

In the Re:Birth Mode, a new Ancient Chaos Orb (Tier 10) that provides even more Stats and Blessing Value will be added.
You can obtain this Chaos Orb from the reborn Serpens appearing in the Re:Birth Mode.
The reborn Serpens appears in the new Domain of Might (a provisional name) you can enter by collecting Chaos Keys (Madness/Hatred/Defiance) and new Materials.

Also, the Re:Birth Mode will have a unique ranking event separated from the existing Standard or Season Rankings and will provide surprising rewards.
To ensure fairness, audits will be conducted after the weekly ranking calculation, and the rewards will be sent via mail to Rune Hunters who are verified that they fairly achieved the ranking.
Upon the end of the season, new Ranking Titles will be granted as a reward for your enthusiastic challenges in such a short time.
Further details of the exclusive ranking event will be disclosed in the upcoming Season 'Re:Birth' update in November, so stay tuned.

Lastly, we will add more Re:Birth bosses in the future featuring stronger patterns and rewards, starting with the reborn Serpens.

[b]■  New Content and Changes[/b]

[b]1. Offering to Twelve Gods System[/b]

From now on, your actions in the world of UNDECEMBER will earn you the blessings of the Twelve Gods in the form of Offering Point.
You can make an offering to the Twelve Gods for their blessings by using the Offering Points.
Offering Points you earned in a season will accumulate so that you can use them in future seasons.
Therefore, Rune Hunters who complete a season will have more blessings from the Twelve Gods and enjoy advantages in the next season.

[b]2. New Skill Rune 'Black Plague' and Improvement to Energy[/b]

A new Skill Rune, Black Plague, will be added.
Although we have tried to position Spell Skills as directly casted skills instead of secondary Trigger Skills in the Season 5 'Exodium', we will add another Spell-type Skill Rune based on our internal evaluation that it was not enough.
The Black Plague is a Spell-type Movement Channeling skill that transforms the character into a poisonous cloud, and the character can move while maintaining the channeling status.
Enemies touching the poisonous cloud accumulate debuffs, and you can deal a tremendous amount of damage to the enemies in proportion to the accumulated debuffs upon canceling Channeling.
We hope Black Plague, with Wings of Ignition added in the previous season, may bring the revival of Spell Skills.

In addition, Energy, which was improved during the last season, will go through another improvement.
Zodiac Nodes to offset penalty Stats attached to the Energy will be added, and new Link Runes to obtain Energy of each Element will be added along with the huge improvement of Extract Energy Rune's effect.
Plus, we made some improvements to Skill Rune effects that functioned as a penalty upon obtaining Energy, to avoid disadvantage accompanied with previous Energy generation.
We hope these changes will allow Rune Hunters to design new Energy builds.

[b]3. Teneo Raid and Improvement to Matching System[/b]

Teneo, the final boss of Kustodia, will appear in the Raid.
Teneo is waiting for Rune Hunters' challenges, armed with more sophisticated and powerful attack patterns.
You can obtain new useful Runestones as a reward for your endeavor, and we look forward to your active participation.
Also, we are integrating the matching system for both Standard and Season Mode after the beginning of the Re:Birth Mode to solve matching issues in Raid.

[b]4. Addition of Guidebook and Improvement to Tutorial[/b]

A Guidebook system will be added for Rune Hunters’ better understanding of the complicated game system.
Currently, we are providing guides on our website, but limited accessibility hinders providing proper assistance.
To solve such an inconvenience, we are adding a new in-game Guidebook system to provide better access to information.
In addition, we are working on improving the tutorial and quests in Saluto for faster and easier adaptation of new Rune Hunters to the game.
This improvement of quest routes will not be limited to the upcoming season but will be made constantly.

[b]5. Balance Adjustments[/b]

A few balance adjustments will be made.
Although we have aimed to provide Rune Hunters with an exciting gaming experience, consideration in the game design was insufficient to support this goal.
We ask for your understanding that we have made this decision after much deliberation between the value of our Rune Hunters' efforts and the long-term stability of our service.

[b] 1) Drop Balance Adjustments[/b]

Drop chances of new Unique Items added in the upcoming Re:Birth Season in the Re:Birth Mode will be equivalent to the existing Hardcore Mode, so we look forward to your active participation.
We are also adjusting the drop chances of Kustodia Tickets and Ancient and Divine Essences with the season update.
Expected amount of drops will be tuned to greatly differ according to the difficulties of Hard Mode.

[b] 2) Adjustment to Fixed Partial Transfer Cost[/b]

We made an update during the last season that improved the Fixed Partial Transfer to add more depth and fun to crafting by providing new ways of Enchants.
While the update worked as intended to a certain extent, we believe it allowed Rune Hunters to craft Gears too powerful compared to the cost and difficulty of crafting.
We concluded that it could be detrimental to balance in the long run, so we are increasing the cost of crafting.

[b] 3) Skill Rune Balance Adjustments[/b]

Effects of certain Skill Runes to which improvement of Energy during Season 5 ironically added penalties will be revised substantially.
In addition, rarely used Skills will be improved.


[b]■ In Conclusion…[/b]

As this is my first Director’s Letter, I had so much to share with you, dear Rune Hunters, so it became lengthy.

In the upcoming Re:Birth Season, we aim to present you with fresh fun in new ways, including exclusive content and events.
(Re:Birth Mode’s exclusive content will be added to the Standard Mode once the season ends.)
Therefore, the duration of the season will be rather shorter, lasting two months, and the Standard Chaos Statue Level will not be reset, unlike previous seasons.

Although it will be a short season, we will do our best to provide you with a full gameplay experience.
We promise we will meet your expectations with dense and exciting content, despite the short season period.

We also ask for your interests in our future season update after the Re:Birth Season scheduled for next January and the Third Anniversary Event, and I will share more details in the future Director’s Letter.
With the update imminent, UNDECEMBER’s development team will stay focused on completeness and stability until the last step.

Thank you. 

Seong Seop Song

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c428697b0f0c62b9c277439fdecc1caf219c6616.png[/img]

[b]◆ Season 5 Zodiac Pass 4[/b]
  A new Zodiac Pass is beginning!

[b]■ Zodiac Pass 4 Period[/b]
 - After the Oct. 10 (Thu) maintenance – Before the Nov. 7 (Thu) maintenance (UTC+9)

[b]■ What is the Zodiac Pass?[/b]
 - By clearing Zodiac Pass missions, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
  You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
 - Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 25, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
- You can purchase the Zodiac Pass with your account from Standard or Season Mode.
- If you purchase the Zodiac Pass in Season Mode, its missions, rewards, and levels will be shared across all the difficulty modes within Season Mode.
  └ E.g.) Your play in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/202617bb72b68f3f5c7325d18d2966a86f544b06.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Missions[/b]
 - You can check missions through the ‘Event’ icon in the game.
 - There are both Daily Missions and Season Missions.
 - Season Missions can only be cleared once during the Zodiac Pass period, and more Pass EXP can be obtained through them.
 - During the Zodiac Pass period, 5 Daily Missions will be given every day, and you can obtain Pass EXP by clearing them.
 - Daily Missions will be refreshed every day at 09:00 (UTC+9).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9af5c1a95f6bb6d435d632218471811cd42f0d8c.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Rewards[/b]
 - Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
 - Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/7dbd870377977c361d30e3848c9ab7e9c7016e81.png[/img]

[b]■ Premium Pass Information[/b]
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, you can receive Premium Rewards
 in addition to Normal Rewards when your Pass Level increases.
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, special benefits will be applied during the Pass period.
● Alchemy Slot +1
● Alchemy Acceleration +50%
● Stardust of Oblivion (Zodiac free reset)
※ Premium Pass benefits are only granted to the mode in which you purchase the Pass (Standard/Season).
 - 1,180 Diamonds are required to activate the Premium Pass.
 - Your purchased Premium Pass and its benefits will only be valid during the Zodiac Pass 4 period.

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ The Zodiac Pass period and details may be subject to change.
※ Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are applied separately for Standard and Season Mode (but they are not separated for the difficulty modes within Season Mode).
※ You must purchase the Premium Pass in either Standard or Season Mode to claim Premium Pass Rewards.
※ Premium Pass benefits are only applied to the Standard or Season Mode in which you purchase the pass.
(E.g. If you purchase the Premium Pass in Season Mode, its benefits will only affect Season Characters)
※ You can see the contents of Chest items through ‘🍳View Info’ in the item’s tooltip in the game.
※ To see chance information for chance-based items, please check this Notice on the official website.
※ Once the Zodiac Pass period ends, your level, activated benefits, and points will be reset and rewards changed.
※ If you have any activated level rewards,
  please claim them before the end of the period (before the 2024 Nov. 7 (Thu) maintenance).
※ For inquiries about the product, please contact FLOOR Support.
※ These products may be resold in a same or similar format in the future.
※ 'Purchase Previous Pass' is not included in the Season Missions of the first Zodiac Passes of each season. 
    Please take this into consideration when purchasing the last Zodiac Passes for each season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Use the Zodiac Pass and add extra fun to your new journey! 

Thank you.

notes.title: Normal/Royal Monthly Attendance
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters. 

A new Normal/Royal Monthly Attendance filled with various rewards will begin, along with the new UNDECEMBER!

Let the Attendance help you with your fresh new start, Rune Hunters!
Please see below for more details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/2f41bf3a24d6ba81648e00d370a583756ed182fa.png[/img]

[b]◆ Normal/Royal Monthly Attendance[/b]
A new Normal/Royal Monthly Attendance will be starting.
   
[b]■ Normal/Royal Monthly Attendance Period[/b]
- After Oct. 1 (Tue) 09:00 - Until Nov. 1 (Fri) 08:59 (UTC+9)
   
[b]■ What is Normal/Royal Monthly Attendance?[/b]
- Normal/Royal Monthly Attendance allows you to earn rewards for 28 days by attending.
- You can obtain even more rewards by purchasing Royal Tickets.
- Royal Tickets can be purchased up to one day before the Royal Monthly Attendance ends.
- When you purchase a Royal Ticket, you can attend up to a day before the last attendance date by using Rubies.
- If you purchase a Royal Ticket partway through, you can receive the Royal Bonus rewards for the days you attended previously.
- Attendance will be integrated across accounts without distinguishing between Standard and Season.
- Any Attendance rewards not claimed by the end of the Attendance will be deleted.
   
[b]■ How to Participate in the Normal/Royal Monthly Attendance[/b]
- You can participate via the screen that appears by clicking the [Attendance] button on the upper-right part of the screen.
- You can obtain the activated rewards by clicking the [Receive Reward] button.
   
[b]■ Normal/Royal Monthly Attendance Rewards[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/8cf30860e22ef6c781b516b32892f7bce55107db.png[/img]

[b]■ Royal Attendance Rewards for Royal Tickets [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/ade2a9e5e239fdb8230aefc94bfd6a634f231a24.png[/img]

[b]■ To Note   [/b]
※ The period and details outlined above may be subject to change.
※ The attendance information is refreshed every day at 9:00 (UTC+9). 
※ You must obtain your rewards directly yourself, and obtained rewards will be sent to your bag.
※ Please ensure that you obtain any activated level rewards before the period ends.
※ You can see the contents of Chest items through [🔍View Info] in the item’s tooltip in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Enjoy UNDECEMBER even more with the new attendance!
   
Thank you.

■ Event Details  
- Use 'Ddakji Draw Coins' to try the Ddakji Raffle and obtain rewards according to the grade of the ddakjis from the raffle.

notes.title: UNDECEMBER Season 5 Zodiac Pass 3
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

A new season of the Zodiac Pass,
where you can get various rewards and benefits through your journey with the new UNDECEMBER, has begun!

Enjoy your new adventures with the Zodiac Pass! 
Please see below for more details. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c428697b0f0c62b9c277439fdecc1caf219c6616.png[/img]

[b]◆ Season 5 Zodiac Pass 3[/b]
  A new Zodiac Pass is beginning!

[b]■ Zodiac Pass 3 Period[/b]
 - After the Sept. 12 (Thu) maintenance – Before the Oug. 10 (Thu) maintenance (UTC+9)

[b]■ What is the Zodiac Pass?[/b]
 - By clearing Zodiac Pass missions, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
  You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
 - Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 25, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
- You can purchase the Zodiac Pass with your account from Standard or Season Mode.
- If you purchase the Zodiac Pass in Season Mode, its missions, rewards, and levels will be shared across all the difficulty modes within Season Mode.
  └ E.g.) Your play in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/f887db59665834245dbe035d3c65b43e39f63d90.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Missions[/b]
 - You can check missions through the ‘Event’ icon in the game.
 - There are both Daily Missions and Season Missions.
 - Season Missions can only be cleared once during the Zodiac Pass period, and more Pass EXP can be obtained through them.
 - During the Zodiac Pass period, 5 Daily Missions will be given every day, and you can obtain Pass EXP by clearing them.
 - Daily Missions will be refreshed every day at 09:00 (UTC+9).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9af5c1a95f6bb6d435d632218471811cd42f0d8c.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Rewards[/b]
 - Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
 - Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/cee7524ffc737e92f9630d9c4ae908c9d0ec17fe.png[/img]

[b]■ Premium Pass Information[/b]
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, you can receive Premium Rewards
 in addition to Normal Rewards when your Pass Level increases.
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, special benefits will be applied during the Pass period.
● Alchemy Slot +1
● Alchemy Acceleration +50%
● Stardust of Oblivion (Zodiac free reset)
※ Premium Pass benefits are only granted to the mode in which you purchase the Pass (Standard/Season).
 - 1,180 Diamonds are required to activate the Premium Pass.
 - Your purchased Premium Pass and its benefits will only be valid during the Zodiac Pass 3 period.

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ The Zodiac Pass period and details may be subject to change.
※ Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are applied separately for Standard and Season Mode (but they are not separated for the difficulty modes within Season Mode).
※ You must purchase the Premium Pass in either Standard or Season Mode to claim Premium Pass Rewards.
※ Premium Pass benefits are only applied to the Standard or Season Mode in which you purchase the pass.
(E.g. If you purchase the Premium Pass in Season Mode, its benefits will only affect Season Characters)
※ You can see the contents of Chest items through ‘🍳View Info’ in the item’s tooltip in the game.
※ To see chance information for chance-based items, please check this Notice on the official website.
※ Once the Zodiac Pass period ends, your level, activated benefits, and points will be reset and rewards changed.
※ If you have any activated level rewards,
  please claim them before the end of the period (before the 2024 Oug. 10 (Thu) maintenance).
※ For inquiries about the product, please contact FLOOR Support.
※ These products may be resold in a same or similar format in the future.
※ 'Purchase Previous Pass' is not included in the Season Missions of the first Zodiac Passes of each season. 
    Please take this into consideration when purchasing the last Zodiac Passes for each season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Use the Zodiac Pass and add extra fun to your new journey! 

Thank you.

notes.title: Frost Strike [Source] Skill Error Issue
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

We have identified an issue where 'Cold Explosion' of Frost Strike [Source] Skill Rune is activated even when the target has been already defeated.
This issue has further revealed that if 'Cold Explosion' is activated on multiple targets continuously, the damage multiplier stat is applied more than once.
Due to the reasons outlined above, the effects of Frost Strike [Source] Skill Rune will be changed as follows:

Before: Cast Cold Explosion on target after a period of time upon inflicting Freeze
After: Cast Cold Explosion on target after a period of time upon inflicting Freeze. Targets that are defeated before the effect is activated will not trigger Cold Explosion.
	
We apologize again for the inconvenience this issue has caused.	
We will always strive to maintain the quality and reliability of our services.	

Thank you.

notes.title: Brown’s Lucky Dice Event
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters. 
  
August heat is hot and intense!  
Brown's Lucky Dice Event is here for Rune Hunters who are here for the Season 5 update, that's just as hot!  
  
Please see below for more details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Brown’s Lucky Dice Event [/b]

[b]■ Event Period  [/b]
 - After the Aug. 14 (Wed) maintenance - Until before the Sept. 12 (Thu) maintenance.
  
[b]■ Event Details  [/b]
 - You can participate in this Lucky Dice Event by pressing on the designated icon at the top of the screen.
 - There are 26 spaces on the Dice Board, and you can obtain the reward that is displayed on the space you arrive at.
 - If you reach or pass by the starting space, you can earn a Start Space Pass Reward.
 - You can check the list of available Start Space Pass Rewards in the lower right corner of the Board.
 - You can only receive rewards if you arrive at the spaces on the Board. Some spaces have 'Special Rewards' as well as basic rewards.
 - If you arrive at a 'space with Special Rewards', you can throw the Golden Dice and try a Challenge to obtain a Special Reward.
※ Even if you fail the Challenge, you can try again if you own 'Golden Dice'.
※ Special Days: Aug. 15 / Aug. 17 / Aug. 18 / Aug. 24 / Aug. 25 / Aug. 31 / Sep. 1 / Sep. 7 / Sep. 8
 - You will move along the spaces of the Board in the direction of the yellow arrow, but you will be able to select which direction to go in if you arrive at specific spaces.

■ How to Obtain Dice 

 Lucky Dice  
- Lucky Dice can be looted from monsters, purchased through the Paid Shop, or obtained by disassembling Golden Dice.
   * You can obtain up to 30 dice on weekdays through looting monsters, and up to 50 on Special Days.
- Up to 5 Lucky Dice can be purchased per account every day through 'Paid Shop' > 'Consumable'.

Golden Dice  
- Golden Dice can be obtained through Start Space Rewards or by looting monsters.
   * Golden Dice can be looted from boss monsters at a set chance after defeating them.
   * Up to 2 die can be looted from monsters on weekdays.
   * Up to 4 dice can be obtained on Special Days.
 - If you disassemble a Golden Dice, you can obtain 2 'Lucky Dice'.

[b]■ Event Rewards[/b]

Dice Board Rewards
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/ae00168c5513496cca844a5e42e170a251f8c5c1.png[/img]

Special Rewards  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/da4563d7e1cdec6cb61ffc727f5d4cdaae515143.png[/img]

Start Space Pass Reward 
* Please check the game for more details about the rewards.
  
[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ The event schedule and rewards may be subject to change.
※ You will not be able to use all event items once the event ends after the Sep. 12 (Thu) maintenance, 
so please ensure that you use the items before then. Unused event items will disappear after the event.
※ Event items may be given through other events.
※ Specific spaces have 'Special Rewards' on top of Dice Board Rewards. You can earn the Special Rewards by meeting the specific requirements. (ex/ Roll a 3 or higher on your dice)
※ If you have already received the Special Rewards of a specific space, or if you have moved past the space, you will not be able to attempt Special Rewards Challenges.
※ The number of times Special Rewards can be obtained is limited.
※ All die has six faces, and each face has a different number of dots ranging from 1 to 6. Each face has an equal chance of appearing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Please enjoy Season 5 with UNDECEMBER~! 
Thank you.

notes.title: UNDECEMBER Season 5 Zodiac Pass 2
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

A new season of the Zodiac Pass,
where you can get various rewards and benefits through your journey with the new UNDECEMBER, has begun!

Enjoy your new adventures with the Zodiac Pass! 
Please see below for more details. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c428697b0f0c62b9c277439fdecc1caf219c6616.png[/img]

[b]◆ Season 5 Zodiac Pass 2[/b]
  A new Zodiac Pass is beginning!

[b]■ Zodiac Pass 2 Period[/b]
 - After the Aug. 14 (Wed) maintenance – Before the Sep. 12 (Thu) maintenance (UTC+9)

[b]■ What is the Zodiac Pass?[/b]
 - By clearing Zodiac Pass missions, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
  You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
 - Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 25, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
- You can purchase the Zodiac Pass with your account from Standard or Season Mode.
- If you purchase the Zodiac Pass in Season Mode, its missions, rewards, and levels will be shared across all the difficulty modes within Season Mode.
  └ E.g.) Your play in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/a622e0a4c3e9d462044f114d0a9c2e6778057890.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Missions[/b]
 - You can check missions through the ‘Event’ icon in the game.
 - There are both Daily Missions and Season Missions.
 - Season Missions can only be cleared once during the Zodiac Pass period, and more Pass EXP can be obtained through them.
 - During the Zodiac Pass period, 5 Daily Missions will be given every day, and you can obtain Pass EXP by clearing them.
 - Daily Missions will be refreshed every day at 09:00 (UTC+9).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9af5c1a95f6bb6d435d632218471811cd42f0d8c.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Rewards[/b]
 - Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
 - Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/63c4e75592ed8f249082fed53c28fc0c56a5349c.png[/img]

[b]■ Premium Pass Information[/b]
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, you can receive Premium Rewards
 in addition to Normal Rewards when your Pass Level increases.
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, special benefits will be applied during the Pass period.
● Alchemy Slot +1
● Alchemy Acceleration +50%
● Stardust of Oblivion (Zodiac free reset)
※ Premium Pass benefits are only granted to the mode in which you purchase the Pass (Standard/Season).
 - 1,180 Diamonds are required to activate the Premium Pass.
 - Your purchased Premium Pass and its benefits will only be valid during the Zodiac Pass 2 period.

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ The Zodiac Pass period and details may be subject to change.
※ Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are applied separately for Standard and Season Mode (but they are not separated for the difficulty modes within Season Mode).
※ You must purchase the Premium Pass in either Standard or Season Mode to claim Premium Pass Rewards.
※ Premium Pass benefits are only applied to the Standard or Season Mode in which you purchase the pass.
(E.g. If you purchase the Premium Pass in Season Mode, its benefits will only affect Season Characters)
※ You can see the contents of Chest items through ‘🍳View Info’ in the item’s tooltip in the game.
※ To see chance information for chance-based items, please check this Notice on the official website.
※ Once the Zodiac Pass period ends, your level, activated benefits, and points will be reset and rewards changed.
※ If you have any activated level rewards,
  please claim them before the end of the period (before the 2024 Sep. 12 (Thu) maintenance).
※ For inquiries about the product, please contact FLOOR Support.
※ These products may be resold in a same or similar format in the future.
※ 'Purchase Previous Pass' is not included in the Season Missions of the first Zodiac Passes of each season. 
    Please take this into consideration when purchasing the last Zodiac Passes for each season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Use the Zodiac Pass and add extra fun to your new journey! 

Thank you.

notes.title: Director’s Letter Vol. 13
notes.content:
[b]Hello, I'm Director Sang Kwon Han.[/b]


We sincerely apologize for the frustration caused by the issues that arose after the 1st update of Season 5.

We regret that you encountered several issues in the updated version, including the abnormal Drop Chance for the new Grade Essences and Tier 35 Gear, the major changes related to Energy, and the problems with the Chaos Dungeons caused by Darkness Energy.

The development team is currently addressing urgent issues and conducting thorough internal checks to ensure nothing is overlooked.
We aim to resolve many of these problems during the Jul. 25 (Thu) scheduled maintenance and again during the Aug. 1 (Thu) scheduled maintenance. 

The issues with Darkness Energy arose as demand significantly exceeded supply. To address this by Aug. 1 (Thu), we plan to increase the Daily Exchange Count for Darkness Energy, add a chance to obtain Darkness Energy when disassembling, allow the purchase of Darkness Energy from Croco’s Disassemble Exchange Shop, and include Darkness Energy Bundle Drops in Hard Mode.
To help alleviate the wait until Aug. 1 (Thu), we will be distributing 1,000 Darkness Energy every day from Jul. 25 (Thu) to Jul. 31 (Wed).

The recent improvements to Energy were intended to address the imbalance that had focused too heavily on specific types of Energy and to prevent over-reliance on some builds.
In the next season, we will introduce new Link Runes to enhance Energy effects and make additional balance adjustments as needed.

Lastly, there is still an issue with the Tier 35 ‘Arcane’ weapon gear, where the Unique Options have excessive stats that were not part of the original design.
Since some Rune Hunters already have these weapons while others do not, we will not be performing a separate balance patch.

However, because the Unique Options on the ‘Arcane’ weapon gear will have a long-term impact on balance, this gear will only be available during Season 5 and will not be obtainable in future seasons.

We understand that some Rune Hunters might be concerned about some items becoming legacies, as has happened in the past. Rest assured, we plan to address these concerns through system adjustments in upcoming seasons.

We put a lot of effort into creating enjoyable content for Season 5, but we understand that the early issues have been disappointing.
To make up for this, we have prepared some rewards, though they may not fully resolve the problems.
We hope these rewards will help Rune Hunters enjoy Season 5 a bit more.

Preparing the rewards will take some time, so they will be distributed to all Rune Hunters during the Aug. 1 (Thu) scheduled maintenance.
The rewards are as follows:
- Tier 35 Gear Selection Chest x1
- [Exclusive] Ancient and Divine Upgrade Essence Selection Chest x2
- [Exclusive] Ancient and Divine Imbue Essence Selection Chest x2
- [Exclusive] Ancient and Divine Reversion Essence Selection Chest x2

Even though Season 5 has just started, we are committed to making UNDECEMBER even better for the upcoming season.

Thank you.

Sang Kwon Han

notes.title: New Ways to Use Essences and Attendance Changes
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.
　
Following the Season 5 update, we have carefully considered the feedback from many Rune Hunters and would like to provide some clarifications. 
　
Firstly, regarding the Essences that were refunded due to changes in the Season 5 update:
Upon review, we understand that there is currently no way to utilize the refunded Essences which were based on the quantities of items held from previous seasons. 
Therefore, we will be introducing new ways so you can utilize the refunded Essences to the fullest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/1c8969a8df7f5c68ce0bedd1b992995d617d9198.png[/img]

Secondly, the New/Returning Attendance will be changed to apply to all users.
New/Returning Attendance that was introduced with the Season 5 update were initially intended only for new/returning users. 
However, after receiving your feedback, we have decided to change the criteria of the attendance rewards to apply to all users, in the spirit of greater inclusivity.
　
Thirdly, the minimization (hide/show) feature for equipment options will be added for the mobile version.
We have added the feature, which was initially not a part of this update, for your convenience.
　
This addition aims to assist Rune Hunters experiencing difficulties with equipment enchantments on the mobile version. 
Please read on for more details.
You can now open and close equipment options on the mobile version as shown in the screenshot below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/15b4fb3fdca25cf650eb5ee95b1fcc6233d3b7cc.jpg[/img]

We are very grateful for the ongoing feedback and support from Rune Hunters.
Please keep supporting UNDECEMBER.
　
Thank you.
