Greetings, Rune Hunters.

A new season of the Zodiac Pass,
where you can get various rewards and benefits through your journey with the new UNDECEMBER, has begun!

Enjoy your new adventures with the Zodiac Pass! 
Please see below for more details. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c428697b0f0c62b9c277439fdecc1caf219c6616.png[/img]

[b]◆ Season 5 Zodiac Pass 1[/b]
  A new Zodiac Pass is beginning!

[b]■ Zodiac Pass 1 Period[/b]
 - After the Jul. 18 (Thu) maintenance – Before the Aug. 14 (Wed) maintenance (UTC+9)

[b]■ What is the Zodiac Pass?[/b]
 - By clearing Zodiac Pass missions, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
  You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
 - Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 25, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
- You can purchase the Zodiac Pass with your account from Standard or Season Mode.
- If you purchase the Zodiac Pass in Season Mode, its missions, rewards, and levels will be shared across all the difficulty modes within Season Mode.
  └ E.g.) Your play in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/5f8a152621fbc50e91027c3b7b4dbc58b4199bcb.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Missions[/b]
 - You can check missions through the ‘Event’ icon in the game.
 - There are both Daily Missions and Season Missions.
 - Season Missions can only be cleared once during the Zodiac Pass period, and more Pass EXP can be obtained through them.
 - During the Zodiac Pass period, 5 Daily Missions will be given every day, and you can obtain Pass EXP by clearing them.
 - Daily Missions will be refreshed every day at 09:00 (UTC+9).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9af5c1a95f6bb6d435d632218471811cd42f0d8c.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Rewards[/b]
 - Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
 - Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/7e4ea5c9377870a551b176fd32c53a8ccbc91863.png[/img]

[b]■ Premium Pass Information[/b]
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, you can receive Premium Rewards
 in addition to Normal Rewards when your Pass Level increases.
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, special benefits will be applied during the Pass period.
● Alchemy Slot +1
● Alchemy Acceleration +50%
● Stardust of Oblivion (Zodiac free reset)
※ Premium Pass benefits are only granted to the mode in which you purchase the Pass (Standard/Season).
 - 1,180 Diamonds are required to activate the Premium Pass.
 - Your purchased Premium Pass and its benefits will only be valid during the Zodiac Pass 1 period.

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ The Zodiac Pass period and details may be subject to change.
※ Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are applied separately for Standard and Season Mode (but they are not separated for the difficulty modes within Season Mode).
※ You must purchase the Premium Pass in either Standard or Season Mode to claim Premium Pass Rewards.
※ Premium Pass benefits are only applied to the Standard or Season Mode in which you purchase the pass.
(E.g. If you purchase the Premium Pass in Season Mode, its benefits will only affect Season Characters)
※ You can see the contents of Chest items through ‘🍳View Info’ in the item’s tooltip in the game.
※ To see chance information for chance-based items, please check this Notice on the official website.
※ Once the Zodiac Pass period ends, your level, activated benefits, and points will be reset and rewards changed.
※ If you have any activated level rewards,
  please claim them before the end of the period (before the 2024 Aug. 14 (Wed) maintenance).
※ For inquiries about the product, please contact FLOOR Support.
※ These products may be resold in a same or similar format in the future.
※ 'Purchase Previous Pass' is not included in the Season Missions of the first Zodiac Passes of each season. 
    Please take this into consideration when purchasing the last Zodiac Passes for each season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Use the Zodiac Pass and add extra fun to your new journey! 

Thank you.

notes.title: Advance Notice on Upcoming Changes with Jul. 18 Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.
  
There will be various changes coming into effect with the new update that is taking place on Jul. 18 (Thu).
  
Among these changes, we would like to inform you in advance of the content that will be reset, information regarding the end of Season 4, as well as certain content adjustments that will take place in preparation for the Season 5 update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Auction House Suspension Measures[/b]
After the Jul. 15 (Mon) patch, you will no longer be able to register new items at the Auction House and will not be able to bid on items that have been registered at the Auction House.
Items that have been registered before the patch will remain registered in the Auction House for their remaining time and can be purchased through buyout.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◈ Content Reset [/b]

[b]◆ Chaos Dungeon Reset and Current Chaos Cards[/b]
With the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, your current Chaos Compendium Score and Chaos Statue Level will be reset.
  
Chaos Cards obtained before the update that you currently own can be used until the update takes place.
Once the Chaos Statue is reset, you will need to obtain new Chaos Cards in order to play Chaos Dungeons.
  
Any Chaos Cards that you do not use before the Jul. 18 (Thu) update will be converted into event items during the update.
The Chaos items that will be converted include all Chaos Cards and Chaos Card Chests, Chaos Keys, and chests that include Keys.
   
※ Unique Chaos Card Selection Chests, Traces of Memory Selection Chests, Legendary Chaos Card Random Chests (Tier 10), and Rare Tier 10 Chaos Card Chests will not be converted into event items, but Chaos Cards obtained by using Unique Chaos Card Selection Chests will be converted into event items.

[b]◆ Removal of Chaos Stones[/b]
※ Chaos Stones will be removed and replaced with Chaos Points starting from Season 5, which can trigger confirmed events.
※ Chaos Points will reset at the beginning of each season.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/dcf7cc45d38ff70bbb8945e8cb0ea5c481c48cc5.png[/img]
※ Changes are subject to further updates.

[b]◆ Black Market Reset[/b]
With the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, the Black Market’s Friendship level, item list, saved items, and Pirate’s Coins will be reset.
  
The Pirate's Coins and Pirate's Coin Chests that you own will be deleted with the update.
Please purchase any saved items before the update takes place. 
  
Your saved items on the Black Market will be deleted after the update, so please purchase them before the Season 5 maintenance.

[b]◆ Relic and Zodiac Reset[/b]
After the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, your Relics and Zodiacs will be reset.
  
Your Relic Level and EXP, and any Light of Life that you own, will be combined based on whichever values are higher out of Season/Standard mode.  
 
All Avatar information will be reset and Divinity Points will be given depending on your combined Relic Level.
  
Please log in after the update to activate your character’s Relic Avatar and reassign your Divinity Points, as well as your Zodiac Traits and Stat Points.

[b]◆ Constellation of Time Reset[/b]
After the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, your Constellation of Time stage and your Powerful Emotions will be reset.
Please ensure that you complete any Constellation of Time stages you are playing before the update.
  
[b]◆ Zodiac Stone Emotion Engraving Reset[/b]
After the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, your Emotion Engravings on Zodiac Stones will be reset.
You can perform Emotion Engraving again through Constellation of Time after the update.

[b]◆ Mastery Reset [/b]
After the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, your Mastery will be reset.
  
Your Mastery Level will be combined based on whichever level is higher out of Season/Standard mode.
Please log in after the update to reassign your reset Mastery Points.

[b]◆ Rune Master Points Reset[/b]
After the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, Rune Master Points consumed for The Path of the Rune Master, unlocking Skill Slots, etc., will be reset.
Please log in after the update to reassign your reset Rune Master Points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Changes to Skill & Link Rune Effects[/b]
With the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, the effects for certain Runes will be changed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/d9980b39a588ed1bd0770492425fe42a4bc48e2f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/70df3f7e49e5a09b2b24f594026fd177d12a9cea.png[/img]

With the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, Energy Effects will be changed.

notes.title: Director's Letter Vol. 12
notes.content:
Hello, I'm Director Sang Kwon Han.

Firstly, we would like to apologize for the issue where the interaction button,
which had been useful in the mobile environment, was not being displayed. 
This problem occurred due to our oversight.

Our development team is also aware of the numerous opinions 
regarding the expanded growth content where Rune Master Points, 
the core of this update, can be used.

The Rune Cast expansion, aimed at fostering growth potential for various builds, 
arises from the broad spectrum of character development possibilities rooted in Rune growth. 

We believe that our positive intentions might not have been effectively communicated, 
stemming from a cautious approach to design due to the diverse variables involved.

The items that can be purchased with points obtained from 
Rune Master Level will continue to be added and improved upon as seasons progress. 

The recent Rune Cast expansion is still new,
so we would appreciate your understanding and patience as we move forward.

We are diligently preparing for Season 5, and we promise to present you with 
an even more enhanced version of UNDECEMBER. 
With this, we conclude this brief developer's letter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c428697b0f0c62b9c277439fdecc1caf219c6616.png[/img]

[b]◆ Season 4 Zodiac Pass 4[/b]
  A new Zodiac Pass is beginning!

[b]■ Zodiac Pass 4 Period[/b]
 - After the Jun. 20 (Thu) maintenance – Before the Jul. 18 (Thu) maintenance (UTC+9)

[b]■ What is the Zodiac Pass?[/b]
 - By clearing Zodiac Pass missions, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
  You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
 - Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 25, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
- You can purchase the Zodiac Pass with your account from Standard or Season Mode.
- If you purchase the Zodiac Pass in Season Mode, its missions, rewards, and levels will be shared across all the difficulty modes within Season Mode.
  └ E.g.) Your play in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/f9bc5430a0f7dc66da5b0885063c9a6abcd265dc.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Missions[/b]
 - You can check missions through the ‘Event’ icon in the game.
 - There are both Daily Missions and Season Missions.
 - Season Missions can only be cleared once during the Zodiac Pass period, and more Pass EXP can be obtained through them.
 - During the Zodiac Pass period, 5 Daily Missions will be given every day, and you can obtain Pass EXP by clearing them.
 - Daily Missions will be refreshed every day at 09:00 (UTC+9).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9af5c1a95f6bb6d435d632218471811cd42f0d8c.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Rewards[/b]
 - Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
 - Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/577ce1a8de585c95a661503aea39c4c00832646e.png[/img]

[b]■ Premium Pass Information[/b]
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, you can receive Premium Rewards
 in addition to Normal Rewards when your Pass Level increases.
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, special benefits will be applied during the Pass period.
● Alchemy Slot +1
● Alchemy Acceleration +50%
● Stardust of Oblivion (Zodiac free reset)
※ Premium Pass benefits are only granted to the mode in which you purchase the Pass (Standard/Season).
 - 1,180 Diamonds are required to activate the Premium Pass.
 - Your purchased Premium Pass and its benefits will only be valid during the Zodiac Pass 4 period.

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ The Zodiac Pass period and details may be subject to change.
※ Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are applied separately for Standard and Season Mode (but they are not separated for the difficulty modes within Season Mode).
※ You must purchase the Premium Pass in either Standard or Season Mode to claim Premium Pass Rewards.
※ Premium Pass benefits are only applied to the Standard or Season Mode in which you purchase the pass.
(E.g. If you purchase the Premium Pass in Season Mode, its benefits will only affect Season Characters)
※ You can see the contents of Chest items through ‘🍳View Info’ in the item’s tooltip in the game.
※ To see chance information for chance-based items, please check this Notice on the official website.
※ Once the Zodiac Pass period ends, your level, activated benefits, and points will be reset and rewards changed.
※ If you have any activated level rewards,
  please claim them before the end of the period (before the 2024 Jul. 18 (Thu) maintenance).
※ For inquiries about the product, please contact FLOOR Support.
※ These products may be resold in a same or similar format in the future.
※ 'Purchase Previous Pass' is not included in the Season Missions of the first Zodiac Passes of each season. 
    Please take this into consideration when purchasing the last Zodiac Passes for each season.

Use the Zodiac Pass and add extra fun to your new journey! 

Thank you.

notes.title: Director’s Letter Vol. 11
notes.content:
[b]Hello, I'm Director Sang Kwon Han.[/b]

As the chilly spring weather drizzles away, we are faced with the approach of the scorching summer.
We are curious to find out if all of our Rune Hunters enjoyed the slight change in the game's atmosphere through the new event.
We aim to continue making various attempts in enhancing the fun aspects of the game.

Now then, allow me to share with you the core contents of the upcoming updates along with the details of the Season 5 update through this letter.
※ The details are still in the planning stage and may change during development.

[b]■ Jun. 20 (Thu) / Season 4, 3rd Update[/b]

The final minor update of Season 4 will present an expansion of the Rune Master feature, as shared in the previous Developer's Letter.
Rune Master Points can be used to unlock slots for the newly added independent Rune Cast to register Skill/Link Runes more freely than before.
Rune Hunters who felt subdued by the existing Rune Cast system will be able to create a wider variety of Rune Builds starting with this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/560588bc31070c0cb860c72ef846fca33ca4419b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/401018ef661941cae02841410a8efc9aa93ea2e8.png[/img]

In addition, the Skill Quick Slots and Trigger Rune Slots can also be expanded by using Rune Master Points to utilize even more skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/5a03c46d447300197dd7fd5d75f093632235aef7.png[/img]

We have also prepared a summer event where you can obtain Swimsuit Costumes, so we hope you enjoy the last five weeks of Season 4.

[b]■ Jul. 18 (Thu) / Season 5 1st Update[/b]

[b]1. New Story[/b]

In Season 4, we shared separate stories by adding Side Quests, distinct from the Main Quest.
And now, we plan to gradually add new journeys to find the hidden Zodiac Masters scattered throughout the world, season by season.
In Season 5, the Main Quest will continue in a new themed stage named Kustodia with the introduction of new characters and bosses.

[b]2. Addition of New Item Grades[/b]

Since the launch of UNDECEMBER, we have maintained the 'Legendary' and 'Unique' grade system for over two years.
And of course, we have added new gear options and tier upgrades to consistently provide enjoyment in farming.
Despite our efforts, we found that staying with the same grades was not providing enough enjoyment in farming, even with the improved Legendary Item Drop Chance and Unique Gear Options.
Therefore, we are adding the new 'Ancient' and 'Divine' grades to enhance the farming experience.

Existing Legendary Gear can be upgraded to Ancient Gear by using 'Ancient Upgrade Essence'.
Similarly, existing Unique Gear can be upgraded to Divine Gear by using 'Divine Upgrade Essence'.
※ Note that 'Legendary Unique Gear' cannot be directly upgraded into Ancient Gear. It must first be reverted to Unique Gear before being upgraded to Divine Gear.
※ Ancient and Divine gear can be applied to all Legendary and Unique gear, regardless of the 'previous season,' and we plan to minimize their impact on the value of existing gear.

We have designed 'Ancient Gear' to have the highest performance as a single gear.
Just as Legendary Options can be imbued into 'Legendary Gear', up to two 'Ancient Options' can be imbued into Ancient Gear.
We are planning to add new and powerful options for Ancient Options not previously available on existing gear.

As for 'Divine Gear', up to two 'Divine Options' can be imbued like to the 'Legendary Unique Gear'.
And there is even a chance for 'Divine Set Options' to be additionally imbued into the gear. These Divine Set Options will become a key feature in assembling Divine Gear.
While individual Divine Set Options do not have effects themselves, they grant more powerful Set Effects as the number of options increases.
We believe this change is expected to impact the efficiency of existing 'Unique Gear' as well.

Also, we have determined that the 'Legendary Unique Gear' are ambiguous and will no longer drop starting from Season 5.
Of course, any existing 'Legendary Unique Gear' will be maintained.

[b]3. Chaos Statue Revamp[/b]

The 'Chaos Dungeons' accessible through the Chaos Statue, marks the start and the end of UNDECEMBER, and is one of the main end-game contents available.
Thus, we have continuously improved 'Chaos Dungeons' by adding seasonal content and random encounter elements.
But having realized that such additions did not resolve the fundamental issues, we plan to address them with a major revamp of the system as shown below.

[b]3-1. Removal of Chaos Stones and Addition of Chaos Points[/b]

The 'Chaos Stones', originally designed to enable more experience of seasonal content and random encounter events, will no longer be used.
After considering the difficulty of obtaining 'Chaos Stones', we found that they did not meet the current needs and decided to improve the system to be more intuitive.
Instead, you will now earn 'Chaos Points' by clearing 'Chaos Dungeons'. The accumulated 'Chaos Points' can then be used to directly select the desired random encounter elements.
Any existing 'Chaos Stones' will be converted into 'Chaos Points' along with the season update.

[b]3-2. Improvements to Greater Chaos Card Acquisition Difficulty[/b]

We are planning to improve the acquisition methods for 'Greater Chaos Cards' in Chaos Dungeons.
Currently, Greater Chaos Cards can be difficult to acquire as they can only be obtained in Tier 10 Chaos Dungeons or above, or through the Black Market.
So, to allow all Rune Hunters to fully enjoy the Chaos Dungeons, we are going to provide additional acquisition methods for these cards.
Each nation's Greater Chaos Cards will be rewarded based on the total number of Tier 10 Dungeon clears for that nation.
Similarly, the total number of Tier 11 Dungeon clears for each nation will offer choices between Greater Chaos Card (Domain of Might), (Land of Authority), (Anchorage of the Golden Ring), and (Ilya's Room)
We will also update the UI to reflect these changes. Detailed information will be provided in future update notices.

[b]3-3. Removal of Chaos Compendium and Addition of Chaos Rune Cast[/b]

The 'Chaos Compendium' provided additional farming effects by earning points from clearing Chaos Dungeons.
But we have decided to remove this feature due to poor accessibility and awareness among Rune Hunters.
To compensate for this removal, the 'Chaos Rune Cast' feature will be added.

The 'Chaos Rune Cast' is a new feature that will provide various option effects exclusive to Chaos Dungeons.
As the name suggests, this system will allow hunters to equip runes, but only the newly added 'Chaos Runes'.
Chaos Runes can be obtained from 'Chaos Dungeons' or the 'Black Market'.

And like the Chaos Statue, 'Chaos Runes' will reset each season.
We have decided to make this a seasonal feature instead of a permanent addition to maintain a stable balance and make diverse attempts.
We hope that this new feature will enhance the farming experience in Chaos Dungeons, and we are planning to make various efforts to achieve this goal.

[b]3-4. Addition of Hard Difficulty for Chaos Dungeons[/b]

We are adding a Hard Difficulty mode as a more challenging and intuitive content.
The 'Chaos Dungeon Hard Difficulty' can be accessed once the Chaos Statue reaches Lv. 20 and above. This difficulty can be selected regardless of the card tier.
Resurrections will not be available in Hard mode.
Moreover, you will face monsters of the highest level with different abilities and additional card options exclusive to the Hard mode.
These Exclusive Options may include challenging effects from Cursed Monsters in Season 4, such as harsh Debuffs and Nullify Immunity.
The newly added 'Ancient Grade Items' will be obtainable in Chaos Dungeon Hard mode.

[b]4. Seasonal Content 'Exodium'[/b]

The content for this season will be centered around the Kustodia Island, a key part of the storyline.
Ancient monsters from the mythical ages will start appearing in Chaos Dungeons.
These ancient monsters will be in a Berserk state, bound by unknown devices, making them hostile towards all Rune Hunters.
They will remain hostile even if the devices are destroyed, but their powers will be weakened with the Berserk status removed.

By defeating the ancient monsters, you will be able to obtain [Exodium Card (Kustodia Island)], and [Exodium Card (Kustodia Temple)], which will grant access to Kustodia Island.
The Exodium Cards are divided into Tier 3, 6, 9, and 12.
Unlike the existing Chaos Cards, there will be a Tier 12, from which you can obtain the [Greater Exodium Card] which can be used to face the final boss.

The new bosses will be significantly more challenging than those from normal Greater Chaos Cards, and will drop 'New Unique Gear'.
Also, the newly added 'Divine Grade Items' can only be obtained from Exodium Dungeons.

[b]5. Improvements to Gear Enchantment and Simplification of Essences[/b]

We plan to improve the Gear Enchant system accessible through NPC Blacksmiths Croco and Kiroki for your convenience.
We plan to eliminate the use of unnecessary essences and integrate those that can be combined for usage.

Magic and Rare Grade Gear will always have the maximum slots for prefix and suffix options.
However, Empty Options Slots will still be available, and Imbue Essences will continue to be used on them
Existing essences that can no longer be used can be disassembled into new materials and traded in for other essences.

Essences related to quality can now be used freely regardless of the gear grade.
This also applies to existing 'Unique' and newly added 'Ancient' and 'Divine' gear. The quality limit for 'Unique Gear' will also be adjusted to a maximum of +30 like for other gear.
However, considering the balance of such 'Unique Gear', further adjustments to the functionality and values of the quality-related essences may be made.

Now, Reversion Essences will be added to all essences of Legendary Grade and above, enabling more freedom in Reversions and Upgrades through enchants.

As we mentioned in the previous Developer's Letter, please note that all Essence Pieces will be removed with the start of Season 5.
Please make sure to use all of your Essence Pieces before the current season ends.

[b]6. Improvements to Dismantling[/b]

Various gear and items can currently be dismantled, but we believe the value of materials obtained from dismantling has significantly diminished.
And since pieces will no longer be used starting from Season 5, dismantling will provide combined materials instead.
We plan to add various items which can be purchased with such combined materials. Further details will become available in future update notes.

[b]7. New Skill Runes[/b]

Currently in UNDECEMBER, physical element builds and attack skills have very high usage rates.
And while spells used from 'Spell Activation on Hit' are utilized often, directly cast spells are not used very often.
Therefore, in Season 5, we plan on adding new skills and improve existing skill that are cast directly.

And as previously announced, the hit count bug for 'Whirlwind' skill will be fixed with the start of Season 5.
Subsequently, the skill damage for Whirlwind will be adjusted to appropriate values in accordance with the hit count bug.


[b]8. Removal of Guaranteed and Reversion Transfers and Addition of New Transfers for Alchemy Gear[/b]

Finally, to offer diverse builds for Rune Hunters, we have provided the convenient features of Guaranteed Transfer and Reversion Transfer through Alchemy.
However, despite numerous updates, the utilization of legacy gear remained high, deterring the gear turnover and the enjoyment of farming in a hack-and-slash game.
Therefore, we have decided not to support Guaranteed and Reversion Transfers starting from Season 5.

In addition to the Season 5 2nd update, we will be adding 'Fixed Partial Transfers' in Alchemy to allow more flexible settings in gear options.
You will be able to select one desired option as the Fixed Prefix or Fixed Suffix, and all other options will be transferred with equal chance.
Also, existing 'Gear Guaranteed Transfer Stone' and 'Star of Regression' will be used as new Alchemy materials after being renamed accordingly.
※ Note that 'Gear Guaranteed Transfer Stone' and 'Star of Regression' items will not be removed; they will be renamed and used as materials for Fixed Partial Transfers.

[b]■ In Conclusion…[/b]

We expect the 3rd update at the end of June to bring about significant changes to existing skills builds.
Furthermore, the Season 5 update planned for July 18 will implement major changes to the gear system.
We understand that there are many other issues which must still be addressed,
but we stand hopeful that the revamp of the Chaos Statue, along with the addition of new gear tiers and grades, will enhance the hack-and-slash satisfaction of UNDECEMBER.
We would like to once again thank all of our Rune Hunter who continue to love and support UNDECEMBER.

Thank you.

notes.title: UNDECEMBER Season 4 Zodiac Pass 3
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

A new season of the Zodiac Pass,
where you can get various rewards and benefits through your journey with the new UNDECEMBER, has begun!

Enjoy your new adventures with the Zodiac Pass! 
Please see below for more details. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c428697b0f0c62b9c277439fdecc1caf219c6616.png[/img]

[b]◆ Season 4 Zodiac Pass 3[/b]
  A new Zodiac Pass is beginning!

[b]■ Zodiac Pass 3 Period[/b]
 - After the May. 23 (Thu) maintenance – Before the Jun. 20 (Thu) maintenance (UTC+9)

[b]■ What is the Zodiac Pass?[/b]
 - By clearing Zodiac Pass missions, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
  You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
 - Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 25, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
- You can purchase the Zodiac Pass with your account from Standard or Season Mode.
- If you purchase the Zodiac Pass in Season Mode, its missions, rewards, and levels will be shared across all the difficulty modes within Season Mode.
  └ E.g.) Your play in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e25da7cfec9690955a2a517ccd71a23dde1a8a3b.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Missions[/b]
 - You can check missions through the ‘Event’ icon in the game.
 - There are both Daily Missions and Season Missions.
 - Season Missions can only be cleared once during the Zodiac Pass period, and more Pass EXP can be obtained through them.
 - During the Zodiac Pass period, 5 Daily Missions will be given every day, and you can obtain Pass EXP by clearing them.
 - Daily Missions will be refreshed every day at 09:00 (UTC+9).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9af5c1a95f6bb6d435d632218471811cd42f0d8c.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Rewards[/b]
 - Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
 - Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/7f83066f068e831b364f6a999f36a3e4f9ab821b.png[/img]

[b]■ Premium Pass Information[/b]
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, you can receive Premium Rewards
 in addition to Normal Rewards when your Pass Level increases.
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, special benefits will be applied during the Pass period.
● Alchemy Slot +1
● Alchemy Acceleration +50%
● Stardust of Oblivion (Zodiac free reset)
※ Premium Pass benefits are only granted to the mode in which you purchase the Pass (Standard/Season).
 - 1,180 Diamonds are required to activate the Premium Pass.
 - Your purchased Premium Pass and its benefits will only be valid during the Zodiac Pass 3 period.

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ The Zodiac Pass period and details may be subject to change.
※ Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are applied separately for Standard and Season Mode (but they are not separated for the difficulty modes within Season Mode).
※ You must purchase the Premium Pass in either Standard or Season Mode to claim Premium Pass Rewards.
※ Premium Pass benefits are only applied to the Standard or Season Mode in which you purchase the pass.
(E.g. If you purchase the Premium Pass in Season Mode, its benefits will only affect Season Characters)
※ You can see the contents of Chest items through ‘🍳View Info’ in the item’s tooltip in the game.
※ To see chance information for chance-based items, please check this Notice on the official website.
※ Once the Zodiac Pass period ends, your level, activated benefits, and points will be reset and rewards changed.
※ If you have any activated level rewards,
  please claim them before the end of the period (before the 2024 Jun. 20 (Thu) maintenance).
※ For inquiries about the product, please contact FLOOR Support.
※ These products may be resold in a same or similar format in the future.
※ 'Purchase Previous Pass' is not included in the Season Missions of the first Zodiac Passes of each season. 
    Please take this into consideration when purchasing the last Zodiac Passes for each season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Use the Zodiac Pass and add extra fun to your new journey! 

Thank you.

notes.title: Issue Relating to Whirlwind Damage
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

We would first like to sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused to your gameplay.

We would like to inform you about the changes to the Whirlwind skill following the May 9 (Thu) update.

Firstly, we apologize for any inconvenience caused by the changes in the skill you might have been using.

We would like to address the issue of Whirlwind's reduced strike count following this update.
This issue is not an error, but rather the result of today's update involving a structural bug fix in the channeling skill.

The channeling skill's base strike count rule per attack cycle was not working properly, resulting in an issue where the base strikes were being applied abnormally.
The May 9 (Thu) update addressing this issue has inevitably resulted in the decrease in Whirlwind's DPS.

The current decrease in Whirlwind's DPS following the update is structurally normal.
However, in consideration of Rune Hunters who may have experienced inconvenience due to the unannounced bug fix, we would like to take the following measures.

We plan to revert the changes made to the channeling skill today as soon as possible.
The issue relating to the bug fix for the channeling skill mentioned above must be addressed.
However, in order to provide sufficient time for Rune Hunters to adjust to the skill changes, we will consider implementing them in the next season.

Once again, we sincerely apologize for not making an announcement in advance.
We will always strive to maintain the quality and reliability of our services.

Thank you.

notes.title: UNDECEMBER Game Operational Policy Changes
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

UNDECEMBER’s Operational Policy will be revised on May. 2 (Thu) 2024

Please see below for more details on the changes in order to avoid any inconvenience to your gameplay. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]UNDECEMBER Game Operational Policy Changes[/b]

✔ Affected Policy: UNDECEMBER Game Operational Policy
✔ Effective Date: May. 2 (Thu) 2024
✔ Key Changes 
3. Protective Health Measures for Customer Service Workers will be added.

✔ Added Information
3. Protective Health Measures for Customer Service Workers
① If, during the consultation process for resolving inquiries arising from game use, any act that disrupts the duties of a customer service worker occurs and causes physical or mental distress to the customer service worker as described in the second paragraph, measures may be taken to limit consultations and game usage to prevent and protect the customer service worker from health hazards under Article 41 of the Occupational Safety and Health Act.
② Acts that disrupt the duties of a customer service worker include the following:
(1) Making an inquiry that includes characters, symbols, images, audio, or videos that induce fear or anxiety.
(2) Making an inquiry that includes characters, symbols, images, audio, or videos that provoke sexual humiliation or repugnance.
(3) Making an inquiry that includes characters, symbols, images, audio, or videos that cause personal insult.
(4) Making an inquiry that contains expressions such as profanity and such that may directly or indirectly cause mental harm.
(5) Making an inquiry that contains jokes or expressions unrelated to the consultation that may cause discomfort.
③ If a customer service worker is disrupted from performing their duties, the following restrictions may apply in accordance with the operational policies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/d24ccb8710b23a5e5bedf8acd53ad0909bacae13.png[/img]
* Disrupting consultation duties may result in the termination of the consultation and game restrictions according to the policies in place.
* If operations are disrupted multiple times after the third offense, the 7-day game restriction may be accumulated.
* If consultation duties are disrupted by multiple accounts from the same device or network connection, it may be considered as being caused by the same user, and game restrictions may be imposed accordingly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Please check the Operational Policy page at the effective date to see the revised Operational Policy.

Thank you.

notes.title: UNDECEMBER Season 4 Zodiac Pass 2
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

A new season of the Zodiac Pass,
where you can get various rewards and benefits through your journey with the new UNDECEMBER, has begun!

Enjoy your new adventures with the Zodiac Pass! 
Please see below for more details. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c428697b0f0c62b9c277439fdecc1caf219c6616.png[/img]

[b]◆ Season 4 Zodiac Pass 2[/b]
  A new Zodiac Pass is beginning!

[b]■ Zodiac Pass 2 Period[/b]
 - After the Apr. 25 (Thu) maintenance – Before the May. 23 (Thu) maintenance (UTC+9)

[b]■ What is the Zodiac Pass?[/b]
 - By clearing Zodiac Pass missions, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
  You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
 - Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 25, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
- You can purchase the Zodiac Pass with your account from Standard or Season Mode.
- If you purchase the Zodiac Pass in Season Mode, its missions, rewards, and levels will be shared across all the difficulty modes within Season Mode.
  └ E.g.) Your play in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c1873dc53b87ebd949ed3653caad556082c8a169.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Missions[/b]
 - You can check missions through the ‘Event’ icon in the game.
 - There are both Daily Missions and Season Missions.
 - Season Missions can only be cleared once during the Zodiac Pass period, and more Pass EXP can be obtained through them.
 - During the Zodiac Pass period, 5 Daily Missions will be given every day, and you can obtain Pass EXP by clearing them.
 - Daily Missions will be refreshed every day at 09:00 (UTC+9).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9af5c1a95f6bb6d435d632218471811cd42f0d8c.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Rewards[/b]
 - Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
 - Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/47ad05e568327e2de8764fcf1f7a2c918b32c779.png[/img]

[b]■ Premium Pass Information[/b]
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, you can receive Premium Rewards
 in addition to Normal Rewards when your Pass Level increases.

notes.title: [Solved] [PC] Information on the Game Crashing in Windows
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

First of all, we would like to sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused to your gameplay due to the issue where UNDECEMBER did not operate correctly in certain Windows PC environments.

Currently, this issue has been solved.
The issue was caused by Windows Defender, the Windows firewall, mistaking UNDECEMBER as a malicious program during the update process, and we confirmed that this issue could occur from time to time when the firewall is updated.

Please update the Windows Defender and re-install the game if UNDECEMBER is still being mistaken as a malicious program when logging into the game.

※ If you continue to experience issues despite updating the Windows Defender and re-installing the game, please contact Support and we will make an effort to assist you as quickly as we can.
 ㄴ Support: [url=https://cs.line.games/floor/support/cs/ko?gameCd=UDG][Go to Support][/url]

Once again, we would like to apologize to the Rune Hunters for the inconvenience this issue has caused.

Thank you.

notes.title: Information on the Game Crashing in Certain PC Conditions
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

Certain Rune Hunters are experiencing an issue where UNDECEMBER does not operate on PC.
First of all, we would like to apologize for the inconvenience caused by the game suddenly crashing.

The Windows Defender Firewall is mistaking UNDECEMBER as a malicious program during the update process in Windows.
We are currently checking this issue.

UNDECEMBER does not cause abnormalities in your PCs, so please rest assured.

This issue can be solved by adding UNDECEMBER to the list of apps that are allowed by the Windows Defender Firewall.
Please see the steps below for more information.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]How to Solve the Game Crashing Issue in Certain PC Conditions[/b]

* Refer to the Microsoft Support link: [Add an app to the list of allowed apps]

* [Start] > [Control Panel] > [System and Security] > [Windows Defender Firewall] > [Allow an app or feature through Windows Defender Firewall] > [Allow apps to communicate through Windows Defender Firewall] > [Change Settings] > Add UNDECEMBER to 'Allowed apps and features'

* [Start] > Windows [Settings] > [Update & Security] > [Windows Security] > [Firewall & network protection] > [Allow an app through firewall] > [Allow apps to communicate through Windows Defender Firewall] > Add UNDECEMBER to 'Allowed apps and features'
※ If UNDECEMBER cannot be found in the list of [Allowed apps and features], select [Allow another app] and add UNDECEMBER through the path that it is installed in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

We would like to remind you once again that UNDECEMBER does not cause abnormalities in your PCs.
We will make an effort to solve this issue as quickly as possible.

Thank you.

notes.title: Director’s Letter Vol. 10
notes.content:
[b]Hello, I’m Director Sang Kwon Han.[/b]

First of all, I would like to thank the Rune Hunters who are enjoying the new season and the Eunos update.
I would like to share information about what has changed with this season's update along with other aspects that will be improved.

[b]■ Issues Regarding Balance and Dual Element Trigger Runes[/b]

Ever since UNDECEMBER was launched and updated, issues related to builds focused on elements have existed.
We were fully aware of the recent issues regarding how certain elements were outperforming others and pondered deeply on how to solve this.
We removed a basic option from Trigger Runes, the "Adds 50% of Main element Increase/Amplification of Activation Skill to Element of Target Skill when the Main Elements of Activation and Target Skills are different" option.
We originally aimed to solve this issue without a downgrade patch, but we came to the conclusion that we would just be fixing the issue temporarily without solving the crux of the issue if we didn't roll out a downgrade patch.

The Link Rune was created with convenience and expanding skills in mind, but it was being used in unintended methods, which tampered with the balance between single-element and multi-element builds.
Because of this, there was a severe difference in the amount of damage some skills dealt compared to others, which forced users to use Trigger Runes.
This went against the Rune's intended purpose of enabling users to expand their skills in a variety of ways.
We have reflected on this issue deeply and will take caution to make sure that issues related to balance like this will not happen again.

Also, Zodiac Tiers 1-9 underwent extensive changes to balance builds focused on physical damage, Minions, and Sentries.
I am sure these sudden changes could cause confusion among Rune Hunters, but please understand that these changes are the foundations that Zodiac Nodes will use to develop in the future.

Lastly, the Charm Blessing effect will undergo similar changes through the Apr. 11 (Thu) update.
The Charm Blessing effect that is used commonly has been lowered, and Casthor's Blessing has been changed to affect damage stats in general, considering how it is specialized for element-centered builds.
Also, specific Charm Blessing effects will be added for Minion and Sentry-focused builds, which receive fewer benefits from Blessings compared to other elemental builds.

[b]■ New Legendary Unique Change Essences[/b]

We are currently aware that the stats of Legendary Unique items' options cannot be changed with Unique Change Essences.
This is because of the restrictions regarding the use of Essences that are divided per grade.
The related Essences will be updated during the season and will be revealed as soon as possible.
We hope that Rune Hunters who have experienced inconveniences related to this issue after obtaining Legendary Unique items could benefit from this change.

[b]■ Additional Rune Master Level Updates[/b]

To increase the fun of investing points in Rune Master Levels, Rune Master Level updates that enable expanding the Rune Cast, Trigger Runes, and skill slots will take place in early June.
Please keep in mind that these updates will be implemented to enhance the fun of raising Rune Master Levels, which enable limitless growth regardless of the season, and to enable users to use an even wider variety of skills.

[b]■ Simplified Essences[/b]

Currently, countless Essences and Essence Pieces are taking up a great amount of space in Rune Hunters' Storages.
Also, the value of Essences has fluctuated wildly, and the process related to enchanting gear using Essences has many areas to be improved on.
In Season 4, a different finished product will be dropped instead of Essence Pieces. (Essence Pieces will still be obtainable through disassembling items.)
Essence Pieces will be removed when Season 4 ends. We hope you'll understand that these measures are being implemented to prepare for improving Essences and the enchanting process in Season 5.
We recommend users to use all Essence Pieces they have during Season 4.

[b]■ In Conclusion…[/b]

Many changes have taken place and new functions have been added in Season 4.
However, there is still a mountain of aspects that can be improved, which the developers are all aware of. We are all dedicating ourselves to prepare for updates and improvements even now.
We will make an effort to continue improving. In the next Director's Letter, I will share more detailed information on Season 5.

Thank you.

notes.title: Advance Notice on Upcoming Changes with Mar. 28 Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

There will be various changes coming into effect with the new update that is taking place on Mar. 28 (Thu).
 
Among these changes, we would like to inform you in advance of the content that will be reset, information regarding the end of Season 3, as well as certain content adjustments that will take place in preparation for the Season 4 update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]■ Auction House Suspension Measures[/b]

[b]◆ Auction House Suspension Measures[/b]
After the Mar. 25 (Mon) patch, you will no longer be able to register new items at the Auction House and will not be able to bid on items that have been registered at the Auction House.
Items that have been registered before the patch will remain registered in the Auction House for their remaining time and can be purchased through buyout.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]■ Content Reset[/b]

[b]◆ Chaos Dungeon Reset and Current Chaos Cards[/b]
With the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, your current Chaos Compendium Score and Chaos Statue Level will be reset.
 
Chaos Cards obtained before the update that you currently own can be used until the update takes place.
Once the Chaos Statue is reset, you will need to obtain new Chaos Cards in order to play Chaos Dungeons.
 
Any Chaos Cards that you do not use before the Mar. 28 (Thu) update will be converted into event items during the update.
The Chaos items that will be converted include all Chaos Cards and Chaos Card Chests, Chaos Keys, and chests that include Chaos Keys.
 
※ Unique Chaos Card Selection Chests and Traces of Memory Selection Chests will not be converted to event items, 
    but Chaos Cards obtained through those items will be converted to event items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Black Market Reset[/b]
With the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, the Black Market’s Friendship level, item list, saved items, and Pirate’s Coins will be reset.
 
The Pirate's Coins and Pirate's Coin Chests that you own will be deleted with the update.
Please purchase any saved items before the update takes place. 
 
Your saved items on the Black Market will be deleted after the update, so please purchase them before the Season 4 maintenance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Relic and Zodiac Reset[/b]
After the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, your Relics and Zodiacs will be reset.
 
Your Relic Level and EXP, and any Light of Life that you own, will be combined based on whichever values are higher out of Season/Standard mode. 
 
All Avatar information will be reset and Divinity Points will be given depending on your combined Relic Level.
 
Please log in after the update to activate your character’s Relic Avatar and reassign your Divinity Points, as well as your Zodiac Traits and Stat Points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Constellation of Time Reset[/b]
After the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, your Constellation of Time stage and your Powerful Emotions will be reset.
Please ensure that you complete any Constellation of Time stages you are playing before the update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Zodiac Stone Emotion Engraving Reset[/b]
After the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, your Emotion Engravings on Zodiac Stones will be reset.
You can perform Emotion Engraving again through Constellation of Time after the update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Mastery Reset[/b]
After the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, your Mastery will be reset.
 
Your Mastery Level will be combined based on whichever level is higher out of Season/Standard mode.
Please log in after the update to reassign your reset Mastery Points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]■ Balance and Content Adjustments[/b]

[b]◆ Skill Rune Balance Adjustments[/b]
With the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, certain Skill Runes' balance will be adjusted.
Affected Runes that are Awakened will be reverted to the state they were before being Awakened after the update, and '[Exclusive] Skill Rune Engraving Stone' will be given.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/6e6c3dd01789b4c781cdadfd647c67a21f2b9cfd.png[/img]

[b]◆ Link Rune Balance Adjustments[/b]
With the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, certain Link Runes' balance will be adjusted.
Affected Runes that are Awakened will be reverted to the state they were before being Awakened after the update, and '[Exclusive] Link Rune Engraving Stone' will be given.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/6b107c1b713d262aab20489a584819952587bef3.png[/img]

[b]◆ Gear Option Improvements[/b]
With the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, options for certain gear will be improved.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/b2a498f2327a47422869ce9efa912aa374ee41b7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]■ Information on End of Season 2[/b]

[b]◆ Season Mode Items That Will Be Moved to Standard Mode at the End of Season 3[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/22cbf9eda8eff5c01b63bbe92d175c9086b47710.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Items That Will Be Moved to Temporary Storage at the End of Season 3[/b]
- The items in your Season Character’s Storage will be moved to Temporary Storage.
- The items registered in your Season Character’s Unique/Rune Compendium will be moved to Temporary Storage.
- The items in your Season Character’s Alchemy Slots will be moved to the Temporary Slots per mode.
- The items in your Season Character’s Mailbox will be moved to the Temporary Slots per mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]※ To Note[/b]
✔ We will not be able to offer you any assistance for any Black Market items that you do not claim before the Mar. 28 (Thu) maintenance.
✔ Items moved to Temporary Storage and Temporary Slots will be deleted if not claimed before the start of Season 5.
✔ We will not be able to offer you any assistance for Temporary Storage and Temporary Slot items from previous seasons that have been deleted once the new season begins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

We hope that the information above will help you avoid any inconvenience as you play the game.
We hope you are looking forward to the new update and Season 4.
 
Thank you.

notes.title: UNDECEMBER Season 3 Zodiac Pass 4
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

A new season of the Zodiac Pass,
where you can get various rewards and benefits through your journey with the new UNDECEMBER, has begun!

Enjoy your new adventures with the Zodiac Pass! 
Please see below for more details. 

※ 'Purchase Previous Pass' is not included in the Season Missions of the first Zodiac Passes of each season. 
    Please take this into consideration when purchasing the last Zodiac Passes for each season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c428697b0f0c62b9c277439fdecc1caf219c6616.png[/img]

[b]◆ Season 3 Zodiac Pass 4[/b]
  A new Zodiac Pass is beginning!

[b]■ Zodiac Pass 4 Period[/b]
 - After the Feb. 29 (Thu) maintenance – Before the Mar. 28 (Thu) maintenance (UTC+9)

[b]■ What is the Zodiac Pass?[/b]
 - By clearing Zodiac Pass missions, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
  You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
 - Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 25, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
- You can purchase the Zodiac Pass with your account from Standard or Season Mode.
- If you purchase the Zodiac Pass in Season Mode, its missions, rewards, and levels will be shared across all the difficulty modes within Season Mode.
  └ E.g.) Your play in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c8576988f569c0263fbd42d1c56a1b830ac97176.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Missions[/b]
 - You can check missions through the ‘Event’ icon in the game.
 - There are both Daily Missions and Season Missions.
 - Season Missions can only be cleared once during the Zodiac Pass period, and more Pass EXP can be obtained through them.
 - During the Zodiac Pass period, 5 Daily Missions will be given every day, and you can obtain Pass EXP by clearing them.
 - Daily Missions will be refreshed every day at 09:00 (UTC+9).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9af5c1a95f6bb6d435d632218471811cd42f0d8c.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Rewards[/b]
 - Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
 - Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/416fc83e449500a364713ff7e2685f2bb00a3392.png[/img]

[b]■ Premium Pass Information[/b]
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, you can receive Premium Rewards
 in addition to Normal Rewards when your Pass Level increases.
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, special benefits will be applied during the Pass period.
● Alchemy Slot +1
● Alchemy Acceleration +50%
● Stardust of Oblivion (Zodiac free reset)
※ Premium Pass benefits are only granted to the mode in which you purchase the Pass (Standard/Season).
 - 1,180 Diamonds are required to activate the Premium Pass.
 - Your purchased Premium Pass and its benefits will only be valid during the Zodiac Pass 4 period.

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ The Zodiac Pass period and details may be subject to change.
※ Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are applied separately for Standard and Season Mode (but they are not separated for the difficulty modes within Season Mode).
※ You must purchase the Premium Pass in either Standard or Season Mode to claim Premium Pass Rewards.
※ Premium Pass benefits are only applied to the Standard or Season Mode in which you purchase the pass.
(E.g. If you purchase the Premium Pass in Season Mode, its benefits will only affect Season Characters)
※ You can see the contents of Chest items through ‘🍳View Info’ in the item’s tooltip in the game.
※ To see chance information for chance-based items, please check this Notice on the official website.
※ Once the Zodiac Pass period ends, your level, activated benefits, and points will be reset and rewards changed.
※ If you have any activated level rewards,
  please claim them before the end of the period (before the 2024 Mar. 28 (Thu) maintenance).
※ For inquiries about the product, please contact FLOOR Support.
※ These products may be resold in a same or similar format in the future.
※ 'Purchase Previous Pass' is not included in the Season Missions of the first Zodiac Passes of each season. 
    Please take this into consideration when purchasing the last Zodiac Passes for each season.

notes.title: Information on Potion Enhancement Effects in Spire of Barriers as of Feb. 20
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

Currently, many Rune Hunters have shown concern over Potion Effect Orbs in Spire of Barriers.
However, we would like to inform you that this is not a bug because it is within the structurally acceptable range.

However, the statistics related to the Potion Effect Orbs in Spire of Barriers were set based on the previous rules regarding Auxiliary Slots.
Currently, all Enhance Potions can be equipped in Auxiliary Slots, so adjustments regarding game balance may take place in Season 4 accordingly.

Game balance will not be adjusted during Season 3 because Solo Descent Raids' pre-season is taking place.

Also, we plan on providing various methods users can increase the effects of potions with later, due to the heightened interest surrounding the stats of potion effects from not only Solo Descent Raids but also the improvements made to Auxiliary Slots.

We hope the information above will help our Rune Hunters enjoy the game.
We will always strive to maintain the quality and reliability of our services.

Thank you.

- Use 'Ddakji Draw Coins' to try the Ddakji Raffle and obtain rewards according to the grade of the ddakjis from the raffle.
- Ddakjis are classified as Legendary, Unique, Rare, Magic, or Normal. There is a limited number of ddakjis that can be obtained each round.

notes.title: UNDECEMBER Season 3 Zodiac Pass 3
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

A new season of the Zodiac Pass,
where you can get various rewards and benefits through your journey with the new UNDECEMBER, has begun!

Enjoy your new adventures with the Zodiac Pass! 
Please see below for more details. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c428697b0f0c62b9c277439fdecc1caf219c6616.png[/img]

[b]◆ Season 3 Zodiac Pass 3[/b]
  A new Zodiac Pass is beginning!

[b]■ Zodiac Pass 3 Period[/b]
 - After the Feb. 1 (Thu) maintenance – Before the Feb. 29 (Thu) maintenance (UTC+9)

[b]■ What is the Zodiac Pass?[/b]
 - By clearing Zodiac Pass missions, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
  You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
 - Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 25, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
- You can purchase the Zodiac Pass with your account from Standard or Season Mode.
- If you purchase the Zodiac Pass in Season Mode, its missions, rewards, and levels will be shared across all the difficulty modes within Season Mode.
  └ E.g.) Your play in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7a56d6cd2e7a933aa791352175c257a820357f4.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Missions[/b]
 - You can check missions through the ‘Event’ icon in the game.
 - There are both Daily Missions and Season Missions.
 - Season Missions can only be cleared once during the Zodiac Pass period, and more Pass EXP can be obtained through them.
 - During the Zodiac Pass period, 5 Daily Missions will be given every day, and you can obtain Pass EXP by clearing them.
 - Daily Missions will be refreshed every day at 09:00 (UTC+9).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9af5c1a95f6bb6d435d632218471811cd42f0d8c.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Rewards[/b]
 - Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
 - Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/dfcfefe322acc0d0c3cafd8ecf1f2915c57a2bdd.png[/img]

[b]■ Premium Pass Information[/b]
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, you can receive Premium Rewards
 in addition to Normal Rewards when your Pass Level increases.
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, special benefits will be applied during the Pass period.
● Alchemy Slot +1
● Alchemy Acceleration +50%
● Stardust of Oblivion (Zodiac free reset)
※ Premium Pass benefits are only granted to the mode in which you purchase the Pass (Standard/Season).
 - 1,180 Diamonds are required to activate the Premium Pass.
 - Your purchased Premium Pass and its benefits will only be valid during the Zodiac Pass 3 period.

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ The Zodiac Pass period and details may be subject to change.
※ Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are applied separately for Standard and Season Mode (but they are not separated for the difficulty modes within Season Mode).
※ You must purchase the Premium Pass in either Standard or Season Mode to claim Premium Pass Rewards.
※ Premium Pass benefits are only applied to the Standard or Season Mode in which you purchase the pass.
(E.g. If you purchase the Premium Pass in Season Mode, its benefits will only affect Season Characters)
※ You can see the contents of Chest items through ‘🍳View Info’ in the item’s tooltip in the game.
※ To see chance information for chance-based items, please check this Notice on the official website.
※ Once the Zodiac Pass period ends, your level, activated benefits, and points will be reset and rewards changed.
※ If you have any activated level rewards,
  please claim them before the end of the period (before the 2024 Feb. 29 (Thu) maintenance).
※ For inquiries about the product, please contact FLOOR Support.
※ These products may be resold in a same or similar format in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Use the Zodiac Pass and add extra fun to your new journey! 

Thank you.

notes.title: Director’s Letter Vol. 9
notes.content:
[b]Hello, I’m Director Sang Kwon Han.[/b]

2023 has come to a close, and the first month of the new year is almost over also.
Did you enjoy the Holiday Event and Coco’s Great Adventure? We made consistent efforts to provide various events to our users after the Season 3 update.

I’m thankful for the support from our many Rune Hunter because I know the lengths the dev team went for this update. However, we will continue to strive in order to provide even better content, for we know the areas we fall short in.
Without further ado, I want to share information about future updates through this Director’s Letter.

[b]■ Feb. 15 / Minor Updates [/b]

[b]1. Improvements to Character Transfer[/b]
The current Character Transfer system contains parts that can be improved.
We want to improve this system because, despite Season Mode, content cannot be fully enjoyed due to Hardcore Mode’s resurrection limits and Origin Mode’s growth limits.
Transfers will be changed to ‘Mode Changes’ and Mode Changes will include ‘Character Reversions’ and ‘Character Transfers’.

Character Reversions are identical to the existing Transfer system. All character information is reset and characters can be moved to any mode.
Character Transfers can only be used by characters in Hardcore or Origin Mode. These characters can move to Normal Mode without resetting information during a season. However, certain information related to modes will be reset.

[b]2. Solo Descent Raid Pre-Open[/b]
As the name suggests, Solo Descent Raids are a new content that allows Rune Hunters to test their individual abilities to their limits.
Since there is no one else to rely on, the difficulty will be extremely high, and characters may struggle to complete the raids if they do not have sufficient attack or survival skills, because the Descent Raids’ boss monsters will become stronger as their HP decreases.
This update aims to serve as a test run of the Solo Descent Raids. We will pre-release three Descent Raid boss monsters, Ochogneel, Carovan, and Magroth.
Rune Hunter Coins will be given to characters who complete Solo Descent Raids. The coins can be used to purchase new, high-performance titles.
The Solo Descent Raids that will be updated on Feb. 15 (Thu) will be a pre-release and will not contain all functions. The content’s direction may be improved or changed based on the Rune Hunters’ preferences and the development schedule.

[b]3. Improvements to Ranking Coins and Shops[/b]
The current Ranking Coins will change to Rune Hunter Coins. The Ranking Shop’s name will change to Rune Hunter Shop accordingly.
We changed the names with the addition of the Solo Descent Raids due to the effects that Ranking Coins have on the content and how the word “Ranking” limits content.
New products will be continuously added to the new Ranking Shop / Ranking Title Shop, and the new products may require additional materials other than Rune Hunter Coins.

[b]4. Improvements to Potion Auxiliary Slots[/b]
The inconvenient and extremely limited auxiliary slot will be improved so that all Enhance Potions can be registered.
Through this improvement, you will be able to increase combat and farming efficiency by registering various Enhance Potions in your auxiliary slot.

[b]5. School Day Ddakji Event[/b]
A new kind of event will be added.
Through the Ddakji Event, various in-game currency, materials, and appearances can be obtained.

[b]6. New Costumes[/b]
New school uniform and gym clothes costumes will be added.
To provide more freedom when it comes to decorating compared to the existing costumes that are limiting, these costumes will consist of head, top, bottom, and shoe costumes.
The specified costume parts will only be applied to new costumes, and will not be available for existing costumes.
However, in the future, we aim to continuously add costumes with specified parts, so please look forward to those. We will make an effort to provide even more various decorations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/18fefbfb4f68a51760120f6e8c0b28b0ddeb8952.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/17e27905abceeb07ce21ade57a80b38d248c896f.png[/img]

[b]■ Mar. 28/ Season 4 Major Updates[/b]

[b]1. New Rune Hunter Registrations / Character Traits[/b]
Existing and new characters can register their Rune Hunter status at the newly added Rune Hunter Registry in every town.
After proving their Rune Hunter status, God’s Blessings and background information can be given to characters, and character growth and builds can be changed according to the selected traits.
In Season 4, only certain gods and background traits can be selected. New components will be continuously added in future seasons.

[b]2. Rune Master Level[/b]
A new leveling function will be opened when a character reaches Lv. 100.
Rune Master Points will be given when the Rune Master Level increases, and the points can be used to invest in additional options.
The levels exist in all modes and do not have a maximum limit.
The areas that the points can be used to invest in will be added through updates during seasons in stages.
With the Season 4 update, points will be able to be used on stats, trigger slots, and skill slots. We are preparing to enable investing points in Rune Casts and additional Runestone slots mid-season.
※ When a season ends, all Rune Master EXP in Season Mode will be added to Standard Mode.
Since a new level will be added, we will heighten monitoring regarding users who use illegal programs to grow their characters.

[b]3. Season Content / Eunos Vein[/b]
From Act 6, ‘Veins’ can be discovered while exploring stages.
From Episode 2, when new veins are discovered in the end content and destroyed, new items called ‘Jewels’ and materials needed to refine jewels will be dropped by chance, and additional monsters will spawn in certain high-graded veins.
The collected jewel items can be refined and crafted by the new NPC, ‘Jewel Crafter Parida’, and special options can be added by equipping jewels in the jewel slots added to gear.
The source of the vein must be discovered to obtain higher-quality jewels and materials, and characters must enter the new stage called the ‘Eunos Vein’ provided by Parida.
The Eunos Vein is a complicated underground world where countless traps, minerals, and powerful monsters appear.
When the object that is suspected to be the source of the vein is destroyed, an event will be triggered. Characters will face more danger as they destroy more and more objects due to the ominous energy increasing in the vein.
The level of rewards increases according to the degree of dangers characters face, but on the other hand, characters may struggle with finishing the content due to the heightened difficulty of the monsters.

[b]4. Gear Sockets and Jewel Items[/b]
New growth-related content called gear sockets and jewel items will be provided by the new NPC, ‘Jewel Crafter Parida’.
Gear items with jewel slots will be occasionally dropped, and collected materials can be used to add jewel slots to gear through Jewel Crafter Parida. 
ㄴJewel slots will be erased when gear items that were gained during previous Seasons are transferred to new season gear items.
Jewel items can be equipped on the added jewel slots, and only jewels that match the slot color and type can be equipped.
Jewels can be classified according to color and type, and there are two types of jewels: Normal Jewels and Star Jewels.
All jewels can obtain unique options through refining and the obtained options can be strengthened with crafting.
Powerful options can be refined on Star Jewels, and Star Jewels can only be equipped on the Star Jewel slot that is only added to accessories.
The above content may change depending on the development schedule.

[b]5. Improvements to Runes and New Link Runes Added[/b]
The Sentry skill, which has been neglected for a long time, will undergo changes that will improve and upgrade its performance.
Also, we are aware that many Rune Hunters have used Whirlwind for a long time because of its convenience. We will focus on strengthening the convenience of other skills rather than lowering the stats of Whirlwind.
A Link Rune that additionally strikes enemies near the target when using a melee skill and a Link Rune that, when attacking with a bow, summons an illusion that repeats the same attack will be added.
Also, we are aware of how the Rune Hunters are unsatisfied with the fairness of Skill and Link Runes. We will make an effort to resolve this issue not through rushed, short-term measures, but with a long-term improvement of the game structure.

[b]6. New Unique Gear[/b]
We are aware that the new Unique gear added to Season 3 gained lots of attention from the Rune Hunters for many reasons.
We have contemplated deeply on the direction we took to raise the value of Unique gear. We will continuously add Unique gear with ultimate options while considering the special qualities of Unique gear.
However, we have no plans of mass-producing items such as ‘Casthor’s Vision’ and ‘Comet’s Perch’.
We will continuously provide Unique gear options that suit the characteristics of the seasons, and since Solo Descent Raids were added to the game, we aim to focus on options related to survival in Season 4.
Unique items that were added in Season 3 will all be obtainable through farming in Season 4 Standard Mode.
This will remain the same for future seasons. Please note that the new Unique items added to each season can only be farmed in the next season’s Normal and Hardcore Modes.

[b]7. Improvements to Trading Post[/b]
Items that could not be registered in the Trading Post, such as gear, charms, Zodiac Stones, and Lacrimas, will be able to be registered.
Please note that these improvements have been made to vitalize the Trading Post.

[b]8. Closing of Origin Mode[/b]
Origin Mode is consisted of a game balance and item drop system that stands alone from Standard, Normal Season, and Hardcore Modes. 
We decided that having this mode be available as a regular season mode instead of a temporary, event mode did not align with the direction of UNDECEMBER.
Origin Mode will be closed from Season 4, especially because we thought that the variety of common event rewards being restricted solely due to Origin Mode was not beneficial.
We would like to offer our sincere apologies to the Rune Hunters who have been enjoying Origin Mode.
However, we would like to ask for your understanding, because we made this decision to focus on the existing Standard, Normal Season, and Hardcore Modes more.

[b]■ In Conclusion…[/b]
We will make many efforts to improve UNDECEMBER in the new year.
We will strive to continuously improve content and provide more things to enjoy.
We would like to offer our sincerest thanks to the many Rune Hunters who continue to love and support UNDECEMBER, and I will return with the next Director’s Letter.

notes.title: Jan. 17 Notice Regarding the 'Absorb Energy' Skill Rune
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

We would like to provide information about the 'Absorb Energy' skill that has become an issue in the UNDECEMBER community.

First of all, we would like to apologize for not providing clear information regarding the 'Absorb Energy' skill and causing confusion.

Rune Hunters reported a total of 2 issues regarding this matter.
Please see below for more details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]■ Issue where energy can be obtained while the effects of the 'Absorb Energy' skill are active[/b]
- Energy should not be obtainable while the effects of the 'Absorb Energy' skill are active.
 This issue will be resolved through the [b]Jan. 18 (Thu) 2024 maintenance.[/b]

[b]■ The Amplification effect of the 'Absorb Energy' skill[/b]
- The following areas synergize with the 'Absorb Energy' skill's Amplification effect.

[b]1) [/b]The 'Adds 50% of Main Element Increase/Amplification of Activation Skill to Element of Target Skill when the Main Elements of Activation and Target Skills are different' option of Link Runes such as Spell Activation on Attack Hit, Spell Activation upon Enemy Kill, Spell Activation on Spell Hit, Spell Activation while Channeling, and Spell Activation on Hit

[b]2) [/b]The 'Increase Max Energy' option of Unique items

The stats were calculated correctly based on the information above.
We are aware that this issue was highlighted in areas where DPS performance can be extremely heightened such as the Training Arena, and would like to inform you that this is not a bug because it is within the structurally acceptable range.

※ However, we are monitoring balance-related aspects, such as the difficulty of reaching the maximum energy limit and maintaining the Amplification effect, and could improve these parts in later seasons if the mechanics are regarded to not be balanced enough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

notes.title: Coco's Great Adventure
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.    
    
Considerable time has passed since our Rune Hunters embarked on their adventure. 
We would like to sincerely thank you for loving UNDECEMBER so far.  
    
We prepared a new event called 'Coco's Great Adventure' to return the love you have shown us so far.  
    
Please see below for more details.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c6c0c07eb00b1f03220d2bfbb9c93cb721833b3b.png[/img]

[b]◆ Coco's Great Adventure Event[/b]   
    
[b]■ Event Period    [/b]
- After the Jan. 11 (Thu) maintenance - Until before the Feb. 15 (Thu) 2024 maintenance 
    
[b]■ Event Details    [/b]
- Capture tiles by moving Coco and obtain rewards by battling enemies.  
- You can move to the next stage if you meet the clear requirements of a stage.  
- Rewards can be obtained according to the number of tiles captured and the stages cleared. 
- You cannot move to previous stages after clearing a stage.  
    
[b]■ How to Participate   [/b] 
- Press the [Event] button on the top-right part of the screen in the game.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/435b1a461835f1b1931ff495e799ee3b3817398e.png[/img]
- If you click a tile in the direction you want to move, Coco will go and capture the tile. You will obtain the rewards of the tile.
- 'Coco's Snacks' are required to make Coco move.   
- Combat will begin if you move on to an enemy tile.   
- Combat takes place by rolling dice, and you will win if the spots on the dice meet the victory requirements. 
- You will fail if you don't meet the victory requirements. You can either choose between the 'Give up' or 'Reroll' button. 
If you press the 'Give up' button, you will move to the previous tile after giving up capturing the tile. The Coco's Snacks you spent will not be refunded.
- After you fail, you can use 'Reroll Tickets' to roll the dice again.
