notes.title: UNDECEMBER Season 3 Zodiac Pass 2
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

A new season of the Zodiac Pass,
where you can get various rewards and benefits through your journey with the new UNDECEMBER, has begun!

Enjoy your new adventures with the Zodiac Pass! 
Please see below for more details. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c428697b0f0c62b9c277439fdecc1caf219c6616.png[/img]

[b]◆ Season 3 Zodiac Pass 2[/b]
  A new Zodiac Pass is beginning!

[b]■ Zodiac Pass 2 Period[/b]
 - After the Jan. 4 (Thu) maintenance – Before the 2024 Feb. 1 (Thu) maintenance (UTC+9)

[b]■ What is the Zodiac Pass?[/b]
 - By clearing Zodiac Pass missions, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
  You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
 - Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 25, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
- You can purchase the Zodiac Pass with your account from Standard or Season Mode.
- If you purchase the Zodiac Pass in Season Mode, its missions, rewards, and levels will be shared across all the difficulty modes within Season Mode.
  └ E.g.) Your play in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/f67da3ae2a7c8302d0140a07f8acf1ea430b8867.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Missions[/b]
 - You can check missions through the ‘Event’ icon in the game.
 - There are both Daily Missions and Season Missions.
 - Season Missions can only be cleared once during the Zodiac Pass period, and more Pass EXP can be obtained through them.
 - During the Zodiac Pass period, 5 Daily Missions will be given every day, and you can obtain Pass EXP by clearing them.
 - Daily Missions will be refreshed every day at 09:00 (UTC+9).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9af5c1a95f6bb6d435d632218471811cd42f0d8c.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Rewards[/b]
 - Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
 - Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/df7cc2d243472026e9ee3a565606b1685c57529c.png[/img]

[b]■ Premium Pass Information[/b]
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, you can receive Premium Rewards
 in addition to Normal Rewards when your Pass Level increases.
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, special benefits will be applied during the Pass period.
● Alchemy Slot +1
● Alchemy Acceleration +50%
● Stardust of Oblivion (Zodiac free reset)
※ Premium Pass benefits are only granted to the mode in which you purchase the Pass (Standard/Season).
 - 1,180 Diamonds are required to activate the Premium Pass.
 - Your purchased Premium Pass and its benefits will only be valid during the Zodiac Pass 2 period.

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ The Zodiac Pass period and details may be subject to change.
※ Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are applied separately for Standard and Season Mode (but they are not separated for the difficulty modes within Season Mode).
※ You must purchase the Premium Pass in either Standard or Season Mode to claim Premium Pass Rewards.
※ Premium Pass benefits are only applied to the Standard or Season Mode in which you purchase the pass.
(E.g. If you purchase the Premium Pass in Season Mode, its benefits will only affect Season Characters)
※ You can see the contents of Chest items through ‘🍳View Info’ in the item’s tooltip in the game.
※ To see chance information for chance-based items, please check this Notice on the official website.
※ Once the Zodiac Pass period ends, your level, activated benefits, and points will be reset and rewards changed.
※ If you have any activated level rewards,
  please claim them before the end of the period (before the 2024 Feb. 1 (Thu) maintenance).
※ For inquiries about the product, please contact FLOOR Support.
※ These products may be resold in a same or similar format in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Use the Zodiac Pass and add extra fun to your new journey! 

Thank you.

notes.title: UNDECEMBER Rune Hunter Growth Pass
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

UNDECEMBER's Season 3 is finally here!
Along with Season 3, the Rune Hunter Growth Pass has also been released!

Play the game with the Rune Hunter Growth Pass to get various rewards as you grow!
You can view the Rune Hunter Growth Pass by pressing the [Event] button on the upper-right part of the screen.

Please see below for more details on the Rune Hunter Growth Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Rune Hunter Growth Pass
The Rune Hunter Growth Pass, which is a product where you can claim rewards every time your character levels up, has been released.[/b]

[b]■ Rune Hunter Growth Pass Period[/b]
- After the Dec. 7 (Thu) maintenance - Until before the Season 4 update

[b]■ What is the Rune Hunter Growth Pass?
- Level up your character to certain levels to obtain various rewards that correspond to each level.[/b]
- Rune Hunter Growth Pass rewards start from Lv. 5 and go up to Lv. 100, increasing by increments of 5 levels.
- You can purchase the Rune Hunter Growth Pass once per mode, and your Pass progress will only apply to the mode in which the Pass has been purchased.
 └ E.g. Passes purchased in Season Origin Mode will not affect your gameplay in Season Normal Mode.

[b]■ Rune Hunter Growth Pass Rewards
- Normal Rewards: Obtain by reaching the required character levels.
- Premium Rewards: Obtain by purchasing the Premium Pass and reaching the required character levels.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/80f7a10b88767ed79201c0e69e667bcd93475d3d.png[/img]

[b]■ Premium Reward Details[/b]
- When you purchase the Rune Hunter Growth Premium Pass and reach the required Pass levels, you can obtain [b]Premium Rewards[/b] as well as Normal Rewards.
- With Premium Rewards, you can claim rewards that are of higher value, such as [b]20 Rune Candor Essences.[/b]
- Purchased Premium Passes are only active during the current Pass period, so please ensure that you claim your rewards before the Pass period ends.

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ The period and details outlined above may be subject to change.
※ Please ensure that you claim any activated level rewards before the Pass period ends.
※ You can only claim Premium Rewards if you purchase the Premium Pass.
※ These products may be resold in the same or similar format in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Experience more exciting journeys with the Rune Hunter Growth Pass!

Thank you.

notes.title: UNDECEMBER Season 3 Zodiac Pass 1
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

A new season of the Zodiac Pass,
where you can get various rewards and benefits through your journey with the new UNDECEMBER, has begun!

A few small changes will be made to the Zodiac Pass for Season 3!
Please see below for more details. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c428697b0f0c62b9c277439fdecc1caf219c6616.png[/img]

[b]◆ Season 3 Zodiac Pass 1[/b]
  A new Zodiac Pass is beginning!

[b]※ Season 3 Zodiac Pass 1 Changes [/b]
 - The Zodiac Pass period will change from [b]2 weeks ▶ 1 month. [/b]
 - The Zodiac Pass max level will change from [b]Level 20 ▶ Level 25.[/b]
 - The EXP you obtain from Zodiac Pass missions will change.

[b]■ Zodiac Pass 1 Period[/b]
 - After the Dec. 7 (Thu) maintenance – Before the 2024 Jan. 4 (Thu) maintenance (UTC+9)

[b]■ What is the Zodiac Pass?[/b]
 - By clearing Zodiac Pass missions, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
  You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
 - Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 20, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
- You can purchase the Zodiac Pass with your account from Standard or Season Mode.
- If you purchase the Zodiac Pass in Season Mode, its missions, rewards, and levels will be shared across all the difficulty modes within Season Mode.
└ E.g.) Your play in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/635224d44737f091d8dee80a83bfe84e6a1300e0.png[/img]
[b]■ Zodiac Pass Missions[/b]
 - You can check missions through the ‘Event’ icon in the game.
 - There are both Daily Missions and Season Missions.
 - Season Missions can only be cleared once during the Zodiac Pass period, and more Pass EXP can be obtained through them.
 - During the Zodiac Pass period, 5 Daily Missions will be given every day, and you can obtain Pass EXP by clearing them.
 - Daily Missions will be refreshed every day at 09:00 (UTC+9).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9af5c1a95f6bb6d435d632218471811cd42f0d8c.png[/img]
[b]■ Zodiac Pass Rewards[/b]
 - Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
 - Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/bf2affd11d312c8f920f2b1310af7a848bfc5456.png[/img]
[b]■ Premium Pass Information[/b]
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, you can receive Premium Rewards
 in addition to Normal Rewards when your Pass Level increases.
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, special benefits will be applied during the Pass period.
● Alchemy Slot +1
● Alchemy Acceleration +50%
● Stardust of Oblivion (Zodiac free reset)
※ Premium Pass benefits are only granted to the mode in which you purchase the Pass (Standard/Season).
 - 1,180 Diamonds are required to activate the Premium Pass.
 - Your purchased Premium Pass and its benefits will only be valid during the Zodiac Pass 1 period.

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ The Zodiac Pass period and details may be subject to change.
※ Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are applied separately for Standard and Season Mode (but they are not separated for the difficulty modes within Season Mode).
※ You must purchase the Premium Pass in either Standard or Season Mode to claim Premium Pass Rewards.
※ Premium Pass benefits are only applied to the Standard or Season Mode in which you purchase the pass.
(E.g. If you purchase the Premium Pass in Season Mode, its benefits will only affect Season Characters)
※ You can see the contents of Chest items through ‘🍳View Info’ in the item’s tooltip in the game.
※ To see chance information for chance-based items, please check this Notice on the official website.
※ Once the Zodiac Pass period ends, your level, activated benefits, and points will be reset and rewards changed.
※ If you have any activated level rewards,
  please claim them before the end of the period (before the mm. dd (Thu) maintenance).
※ For inquiries about the product, please contact FLOOR Support.
※ These products may be resold in a same or similar format in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Use the Zodiac Pass and add extra fun to your new journey! 

Thank you.

notes.title: UNDECEMBER Holiday Event
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

It's December, the finale of 2023!
We prepared a [b]Holiday Event[/b] for Rune Hunters who are here to enjoy the Season 3 update!

From the [b]2 types of gift boxes from Puru[/b] that can be obtained during the event period to the [b]Event Shop[/b] where the festive spirit is all around!

Please see below for more details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e418d0c1706e425a7e8cb4f71999bb6939f2bde5.jpg[/img]

[b]◆ Defeat the Holiday Santa Purus![/b]

[b]■ Event Period[/b]
- From Dec. 7 (Thu) 2023 - Before the Jan. 11 (Thu) 2024 maintenance (UTC+9)

[b]■ Event Details[/b]
- When the [b]Gift King's Assistants[/b] that appear in stages during the event period are defeated, a portal that leads to Santa's Temporary Camp will appear at a set chance.
- Santa's Temporary Camp will remain for a certain time immediately after it appears.
The camp will disappear once the time limit is up and if characters have entered the camp when it disappears, they will be moved to the stage.
- [b]Santa's Giant Treasure Chest[/b] will be at the center of Santa's Temporary Camp and it can be opened until it becomes Santa's Small Treasure Chest.
- A Gift King's Assistant or Grave Robber King Puru will appear when a chest is opened and Puru's Suspicious Gift Box along with various items can be obtained at a set chance when they are defeated.
- [b]Burning Hearts[/b] can be obtained at a set chance after defeating monsters during the event period, and they can be exchanged with various rewards through the[b] NPC, Biologist Vincis.[/b]
- Burning Hearts can be exchanged for the Chaos Card (Santa's Cabin) item 20 times a week per account through the NPC, 
Biologist Vincis. These Chaos Cards can be used to enter the special Unique Dungeon, Santa's Cabin. 
- [b]Sticky Ice Brains[/b] and [b]Gift King Puru's Generous Gift Boxes[/b] can be obtained after defeating the boss of Santa's Cabin, [b]Gift King Puru.[/b]
- [b]Sticky Ice Brains[/b] can be exchanged with various rewards, including the [b]Holiday Costume[/b] and [b]Holiday Attachment[/b], through the [b]NPC, Biologist Vincis.[/b]


[b]■ Puru's Suspicious Gift Box Contents[/b]
- You can get 1 of the following items according to chance if you use Puru's Suspicious Gift Box.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/7bf95b764b28eaf67578388753a4fbefef8f331b.png[/img]

[b]■ Gift King Puru's Generous Gift Box Contents[/b]
- You can get 1 of the following items according to chance if you use Gift King Puru's Generous Gift Box.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/90ec8a49ff6d258e3ed43cf8b8c0853dad317029.png[/img]

[b]■ NPC Biologist Vincis Shop Contents[/b]
- Burning Hearts and Sticky Ice Brains can be used to exchange with various rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/11f968c180ed3e5a8d9b87b8654d3c14a7020a73.png[/img]

[b]■ Event Items[/b]
 - Holiday Special Rune Chest: A random chest containing Skill and Link Runes that can only be obtained from the Guild Shop.
 - Soft Snowflake Cake: A consumable item that grants various buffs when used.

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ The event schedule and rewards may be subject to change.
※ You will not be able to use the following 4 event items once the event ends after the Jan. 11 (Thu) 2024 maintenance, 
so please ensure that you use the items before then. Unused event items will disappear after the event.
 - Burning Heart
 - Sticky Ice Brain
 - Puru's Suspicious Gift Box
 - Gift King Puru's Generous Gift Box
※ Please make sure to not sell event items to the shop accidentally.
※ Event items may be rewarded through other events.
※ Santa's Temporary Camp will remain for a certain time immediately after it appears. 
The camp will disappear once the time limit is up and if characters have entered the camp when it disappears, they will be moved to the stage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

We hope you spend joyful holidays with UNDECEMBER!

Thank you.

notes.title: Advance Notice on Upcoming Changes with Dec. 7 Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

There will be various changes coming into effect with the new update that is taking place on Dec. 7 (Thu).

Among these changes, we would like to inform you in advance of the content that will be reset, information regarding the end of Season 2, 
as well as content adjustments that will take place in preparation for the Season 3 update.

[b]■ Auction House Suspension Measures[/b]

[b]◆ Auction House Suspension Measures[/b]

After the Dec. 4 (Mon). patch, you will no longer be able to register new items at the Auction House.
Items that are registered before the patch will remain registered in the Auction House for their remaining time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]■ Content Reset[/b]

[b]◆ Chaos Dungeon Reset and Current Chaos Cards[/b]

With the Dec. 7 (Thu) update, your current Chaos Compendium Score and Chaos Statue Level will be reset.

Chaos Cards obtained before the update that you currently own can be used until the update takes place.
Once the Chaos Statue is reset, you will need to obtain new Chaos Cards in order to play Chaos Dungeons.

Any Chaos Cards that you do not use before the Dec. 7 (Thu) update will be converted into event items during the update. 
The Chaos items that will be converted include all Chaos Cards and Chaos Card Chests, Chaos Keys and chests that include Chaos Keys.

All Avatar information will be reset and Divinity Points will be given depending on your combined Relic Level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

notes.title: UNDECEMBER Black Friday Event
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

The biggest sale of the year!
The Black Friday Event is here to help our Rune Hunters de-stress!

From the 'Black Friday Pass' with special rewards to the 'Diamond 1+1 Event' that provides 200% of the existing products!

Please see below for more details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/ef7b8683f3a0e7a8a5a55b343e122ff8088da37e.png[/img]

[b]◆ Black Friday Special Product - Black Friday Pass[/b]

To celebrate the Black Friday Event, the 'Black Friday Pass' with many more benefits than the existing Zodiac Pass is available.
※ Zodiac Pass Season 7 will not be available.

[b]■ Black Friday Pass Period[/b]
- After the Nov. 23 (Thu) maintenance - Until before the Season 3 update maintenance

[b]■ What is the Black Friday Pass?[/b]
- Various rewards for each Pass Level can be obtained when the Pass Level is increased through the EXP from clearing the Missions of the Black Friday Pass.
- There are Pass Rewards up to Level 20, and the rewards can only be obtained once per level.
- You can purchase the Black Friday Pass with your account from Standard or Season Mode.
- If you purchase the Black Friday Pass in Season Mode, its missions, rewards, and levels will be shared across all the difficulty modes within Season Mode.
 └ E.g. Playing in Standard Mode will not affect the Season Mode Pass.

[b]■ Black Friday Pass Missions[/b]
- They can be seen in Events within the game.
- There are Daily Missions and Season Missions.
- Season Missions can only be cleared once during the Black Friday Pass period, and more Pass EXP can be obtained.
- During the Black Friday Pass period, 5 Daily Missions are given every day, and Pass EXP can be obtained from clearing them.
- The Daily Missions are renewed every day at 09:00 (UTC+9).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9af5c1a95f6bb6d435d632218471811cd42f0d8c.png[/img]

[b]■ Black Friday Pass Reward Contents[/b]
- Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when the Black Friday Pass Level increases.
- Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when the Black Friday Pass Level increases after purchasing the Premium Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c0e4cf9087bd0e04c80ac0df49a5fcd34a8cb656.png[/img]

[b]■ Premium Pass Information[/b]
- When the Premium Pass is purchased, Premium Rewards can be obtained along with normal rewards when the Pass Level increases.
- When the Premium Pass is purchased, Special Benefits are available during the Pass period.
Alchemy Slot +1
Alchemy Acceleration +50%
Stardust of Oblivion effect (Free Zodiac reset)
     ※ The Premium Pass benefits are only applied to the mode that the pass was purchased in.
- 455 Diamonds are needed to activate the Premium Pass.
- The purchased Premium Pass and its benefits are only applied during the Black Friday Pass period.

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ The Black Friday Pass period and details may be subject to change.
※ Black Friday Pass missions, rewards, and levels are applied separately for Standard and Season Mode (but they are not separated for the difficulty modes within Season Mode).
※ You must purchase the Premium Pass in either Standard or Season Mode to claim Premium Pass Rewards.
※ Premium Pass benefits are only applied to the Standard or Season Mode in which you purchase the pass. (E.g. If you purchase the Premium Pass in Season Mode, its benefits will only affect Season Characters)
※ You can see the contents of Chest items through [🔍View Info] in the item’s tooltip in the game.
※ To see chance information for chance-based items, please check this ▶Notice on the official website.
※ Once the Black Friday Pass period ends, your level, activated benefits, and points will be reset and rewards changed.
※ If you have any activated level rewards, please claim them before the end of the period (before the Season 3 update maintenance).
※ For inquiries about the product, please contact FLOOR Support.
※ These products may be resold in a same or similar format in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]■ Event Period[/b]

[b]■ Event Details[/b]

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ Event details may be subject to change.

※ [u][b]The Diamond 1+1 Event Product is not available on Steam. Please use other platforms[/b][/u].

Please enjoy UNDECEMBER with the Black Friday Event.

Thank you.

notes.title: Director’s Letter Vol. 8
notes.content:
[b]Hello, I’m Director Sang Kwon Han.[/b]

I hope you are well despite the changing season and winter chill. I imagine that things have been quiet since the end of UNDECEMBER’s Halloween Event.

As director, my first concern was on how to ensure that Rune Hunters were enjoying UNDECEMBER. That is why we held the Halloween Event, and while doing so, we found that there were still various shortcomings.

However, even though our first steps may be small, we will continue to work hard to ensure that Rune Hunters can fully enjoy the game. In this spirit, we wish to share some details on the upcoming Season 3 update.

[b]■ December Season 3 Update[/b]

The Season 3 update will be taking place soon on Dec. 7 (Thu). We have worked hard to improve some of the shortcomings of Season 2 and to ensure that players can experience the enjoyment that comes from farming.

[b]1. Improvements to Episodes[/b]
While we improved the gameplay routes for Episodes 1 and 2 in order to decrease repetitive play, we were unable to implement the same measures for Episode 3. But with Season 3, we have reduced the gameplay routes for Episode 3 Act 11 and 12 to the minimum, which will allow users to reach end content more quickly. However, as the Hira theme is common to both Season 2 and 3, we believe that it is premature for us to reduce the gameplay routes for Act 13, and will therefore only do so for another season in the future.

Moreover, in consideration of those Rune Hunters who may not place much importance on completing the game’s stories, we have added an ‘Episode Skip’ feature. Once you use the ‘Episode Skip Ticket’, you can skip the Episode sections you want to, and appropriate EXP and base rewards that will allow you to play the next section will be provided.
* The Episode Skip feature can be used by purchasing an ‘Episode Skip Ticket’ from the Shop after the Season 3 update.
* Please note that you will be removed from content rankings if you skip Episodes.

[b]2. New Runes and Improvements[/b]
As mentioned in the Director’s Letter that was published in September, we have worked to improve Physical Element builds. To supplement some inconvenient factors that have existed since the beginning as well as the weaker areas of Physical Element builds, we have added the new Runes below.

[b]2 new Skill Runes will be added.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e0deeb3a6c67839402c345e522faa8d895ce2a94.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=UyIr30F51EQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=3Ps6mQDgk8g;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]3 new Link Runes will be added.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/6ea8d74e42f8c74aa6a40fe289d3ec7d5443bb08.png[/img]

Despite the addition of these new Runes, we realize that they are not enough to bring about a complete change to Physical Element builds. We consider this as only the beginning of our efforts to continuously improve the game.

[b]3. New Unique items and Changes to Skill Mechanisms[/b]
The new Unique items that will be added with Season 3 will bring about significant changes to the roles played by currently neglected Unique Gear. The new Unique Gear will either significantly change skill mechanisms or will have critical options that will play a key role in completing your build. In addition, please note that most of the upcoming changes are centered around Physical Skill Runes as we have focused on improving Physical Element builds for the new season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/7702e5c72844bb9b683075c09abfa8646cdacd61.png[/img]

New Unique Gear with certain options that are normally categorized as Legacy options will be added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/507983a68034ec8de41ca4b2617b8bb1c273cf66.png[/img]

In addition to the Transcendent Unique Gear above that will affect skill mechanisms, Unique Gear that will only drop in Hardcore Mode will also be added. These Unique Gear that are only dropped in Hardcore Mode are highly effective, and will help to heighten the fun of farming that is inherent to this mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/a7901fccdb889796ca214c6714af2f9d77b689b1.png[/img]

Various other Unique items will be added along with the ones outlined above, and the ones with more powerful options will only be obtainable from the more difficult sections of the game’s end content. However, please note that the options and values of the new Unique items, including the ones outlined above, may change once the update actually takes place.

[b]4. New Legendary Lacrima Gear[/b]
With the addition of Lacrimas in Season 2, we believe that we were able to significantly increase the breadth of character growth. However, we realize that we neglected to fully exhibit the distinct characteristics of the Lacrima gear, and that is why we will be adding Legendary Lacrimas to the game. Legendary Lacrimas will have 3 gear slots, and 1 Unique slot will be guaranteed. The other slots will be set from Magic to Unique grade according to set chances.

Legendary Lacrima Gear

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/eb4e66dc7c2c8c9513f281bfff333bfbc7f263fe.png[/img]

Moreover, the parts for the Unique Gear slots that can be attached to Legendary Lacrimas will be set according to set chances. We decided that the requirements for equipping gear to current Unique Lacrimas were too limited, and that we wanted to provide a wider equipping range with the new Legendary Lacrimas. Our aim is to ensure that as we improve current Unique items and add new ones, they can be used in various ways through Legendary Lacrimas.

[b]5. Improvements to Chaos Dungeons[/b]
Even though Chaos Dungeons are a key part of UNDECEMBER’s end content, we realize that they still have many problems. We are considering all angles in order to come up with solutions to these problems, and our current aim is to consistently improve the content over time rather than to come up with an immediate and rushed solution. Contrary to the fact that the difficulty levels of Chaos Dungeons suddenly increase from card Lv. 15 and above, the enjoyment that comes from farming is relatively lacking. To tackle this issue, new farming monsters will sometimes appear in dungeons of card Lv. 16 or above. As much as the new farming monsters will be powerful, they will drop befitting rewards. The rewards that are dropped by chance include the Charm Legendary Reversion Essences that were introduced in Season 2, and the powerful Unique Gear that will be newly added. The chances of the new farming monsters appearing will increase the higher the card level, and the max card growth level will be increased to Lv. 35.

Furthermore, convenience improvements are planned for Chaos Dungeons in January.

[b]6. Improvements to Rankings[/b]
We are still reflecting on the fact that we had to suddenly close the game’s Ranking Reward feature during the Season 2 update due to structural issues found with Rankings. We have therefore implemented improvements so that from Season 3, Rankings will end during the season and rewards can be claimed in time with the end of Rankings. We will also be simplifying the currently complicated Ranking categories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/de14f171e394b224317b7ecc902fbc6ca936497e.png[/img]

[b]7. Free Pet Ability[/b]
From Season 3, Pet Abilities will be free. They will also be updated so that they are maintained constantly.

[b]8. New Appearance Feature and Improvements[/b]
Wings will be added to the game as a new Appearance feature. A Wings category will be added to costume slots and you can view the products that are available from the Beauty shop. 5 new Wings will be added with Season 3, and they can be obtained both by completing certain content or by purchasing products.

[b]9. End of Crusade of Glory[/b]
As participation rates for the game’s Crusade of Glory are lower than expected, we have decided to permanently close the content. However, rewards for the progress made in Season 2 will still be available to claim after the start of Season 3, and can be used at the Crusade of Glory Shop.

[b]■ Events[/b]
While running the game until now, we have felt that there has been a lack of events in the game. With a Christmas Event that will be as bountiful as the Halloween Event planned for Season 3, we are planning on consistently opening various events so that Rune Hunters can enjoy abundant experiences with UNDECEMBER.

[b]■ In Conclusion…[/b]
The upcoming Season 3 may still seem imperfect at the moment, but we will continue to work hard to add new content that will satisfy Rune Hunters for Season 4 as well. We thank you for your continued support of UNDECEMBER, and we look forward to seeing you in the next Director’s Letter.

[b]◆ Season 2 Zodiac Pass 6[/b]
  A new Zodiac Pass is beginning!

[b]■ Zodiac Pass 6 Period[/b]
 - After the Nov. 9 (Thu) maintenance – Before the Nov. 23 (Thu) maintenance (UTC+9)

[b]■ What is the Zodiac Pass?[/b]
 - By clearing Zodiac Pass missions, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
  You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
 - Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 20, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
- You can purchase the Zodiac Pass with your account from Standard or Season Mode.
- If you purchase the Zodiac Pass in Season Mode, its missions, rewards, and levels will be shared across all the difficulty modes within Season Mode.
└ E.g.) Your play in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/85c3402a5e361d32bd06beb655f575b81341511f.png[/img]
[b]■ Zodiac Pass Missions[/b]
 - You can check missions through the ‘Event’ icon in the game.
 - There are both Daily Missions and Season Missions.
 - Season Missions can only be cleared once during the Zodiac Pass period, and more Pass EXP can be obtained through them.
 - During the Zodiac Pass period, 5 Daily Missions will be given every day, and you can obtain Pass EXP by clearing them.
 - Daily Missions will be refreshed every day at 09:00 (UTC+9).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9af5c1a95f6bb6d435d632218471811cd42f0d8c.png[/img]
[b]■ Zodiac Pass Rewards[/b]
 - Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
 - Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9a68a4df73e050f1ad075e8703067de1018d4d02.png[/img]

 in addition to Normal Rewards when your Pass Level increases.
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, special benefits will be applied during the Pass period.
● Alchemy Slot +1
● Alchemy Acceleration +50%
● Stardust of Oblivion (Zodiac free reset)
※ Premium Pass benefits only apply to the mode in which you purchase the Pass.
 - 455 Diamonds are required to activate the Premium Pass.
 - Your purchased Premium Pass and its benefits will only be valid during the Zodiac Pass 6 period.

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ The Zodiac Pass period and details may be subject to change.
※ Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are applied separately for Standard and Season Mode (but they are not separated for the difficulty modes within Season Mode).
※ You must purchase the Premium Pass in either Standard or Season Mode to claim Premium Pass Rewards.
※ Premium Pass benefits are only applied to the Standard or Season Mode in which you purchase the pass.
(E.g. If you purchase the Premium Pass in Season Mode, its benefits will only affect Season Characters)

※ Once the Zodiac Pass period ends, your level, activated benefits, and points will be reset and rewards changed.
※ If you have any activated level rewards,
  please claim them before the end of the period (before the Nov. 23 (Thu) maintenance).
※ For inquiries about the product, please contact FLOOR Support.
※ These products may be resold in a same or similar format in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Use the Zodiac Pass and add extra fun to your new journey! 

Thank you.

notes.title: Notice Regarding Zodiac Point Decrease after Oct. 12 Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

This is a notice for Rune Hunters whose Zodiacs were reset or whose Zodiac Points decreased after the Oct. 12 (Thu) scheduled maintenance.

The two situations mentioned above occurred while adjusting the Zodiac Points of certain characters to be within normal ranges. Certain characters had abnormally high Zodiac Points due to obtaining the 'Stardust of Evolution' from a bug before the Oct. 12 (Thu) scheduled maintenance.

'Stardust of Evolution' and 'Stardust of Evolution Ⅱ', which can be used to earn Zodiac Points, are obtainable through Saluto's Chaos Sub Quest. All items can be acquired after completing the four quests below.

■ Quests where Stardust of Evolution can be obtained
1) Long-haired Stranger (Talk to Leon)
2) Direction of Worry (Talk to Leon)

■ Quests where Stardust of Evolution Ⅱ can be obtained
1) Resurrecting Evil (Defeat Serpens)
2) Shadow Game (Talk to the Long-haired Stranger)

Please keep in mind that Zodiac Specialization Points can be invested to the maximum level after completing all of the Chaos Sub Quests above and using the Stardust of Evolution.

Thank you.

notes.title: UNDECEMBER Season 2 Zodiac Pass 4
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

A new season of the Zodiac Pass,
where you can get various rewards and benefits through your journey with the new UNDECEMBER, has begun!

Enjoy your new adventures with the Zodiac Pass!
Please see below for more details. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c428697b0f0c62b9c277439fdecc1caf219c6616.png[/img]

[b]◆ Season 2 Zodiac Pass 4[/b]
  A new Zodiac Pass is beginning!

[b]■ Zodiac Pass 4 Period[/b]
 - After the Oct. 12 (Thu) maintenance – Before the Oct. 26 (Thu) maintenance (UTC+9)

[b]■ What is the Zodiac Pass?[/b]
 - By clearing Zodiac Pass missions, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
  You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
 - Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 20, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
 - Zodiac Passes will proceed according to mode within your account.
This means that Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are shared within each mode.
└ E.g.) Your play in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/eb7b2582b4710141279719da1044f16140a8a812.png[/img]
[b]■ Zodiac Pass Missions[/b]
 - You can check missions through the ‘Event’ icon in the game.
 - There are both Daily Missions and Season Missions.
 - Season Missions can only be cleared once during the Zodiac Pass period, and more Pass EXP can be obtained through them.
 - During the Zodiac Pass period, 5 Daily Missions will be given every day, and you can obtain Pass EXP by clearing them.
 - Daily Missions will be refreshed every day at 09:00 (UTC+9).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9af5c1a95f6bb6d435d632218471811cd42f0d8c.png[/img]
[b]■ Zodiac Pass Rewards[/b]
 - Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
 - Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/fe30519c5cde409b17b08f93f768254876ec1a37.png[/img]
[b]■ Premium Pass Information[/b]
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, you can receive Premium Rewards
 in addition to Normal Rewards when your Pass Level increases.
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, special benefits will be applied during the Pass period.
● Alchemy Slot +1
● Alchemy Acceleration +50%
● Stardust of Oblivion (Zodiac free reset)
※ Premium Pass benefits only apply to the mode in which you purchase the Pass.
 - 455 Diamonds are required to activate the Premium Pass.
 - Your purchased Premium Pass and its benefits will only be valid during the Zodiac Pass 4 period.

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ The Zodiac Pass period and details may be subject to change.
※ Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are applied separately for each mode (Standard/Season Mode).
※ Premium Pass rewards can only be claimed for each mode
  by purchasing the Pass separately for both Standard and Season Mode.
※ Premium Pass benefits only apply to the mode in which you purchase the Pass.
  (E.g. A Premium Pass purchased in Season Mode only applies to Season characters)
※ You can see the contents of Chest items through ‘🍳View Info’ in the item’s tooltip in the game.
※ To see chance information for chance-based items, please check this Notice on the official website.
※ Once the Zodiac Pass period ends, your level, activated benefits, and points will be reset and rewards changed.
※ If you have any activated level rewards,
  please claim them before the end of the period (before the Oct. 26 (Thu) maintenance).
※ For inquiries about the product, please contact FLOOR Support.
※ These products may be resold in a same or similar format in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Use the Zodiac Pass and add extra fun to your new journey! 

Thank you.

notes.title: Notice Regarding Legendary Grade Unique Gear Transfer Issue
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

We would first like to sincerely apologize for the confusion caused by the game’s Legendary Grade Unique Gear transfer issue.

To resolve this issue where Legendary Grade Unique Gear can be transferred to Normal Gear, resulting in items with incorrect options, we first implemented initial measures through the server patch that took place earlier today, and further work is now taking place in order to resolve the issue fully.

We understand that issues regarding gear options can significantly influence the game’s balance, and we realize that we should have been more careful to ensure that such an issue never occurred in the first place. We would like to apologize again for this error.

Any gear that was created with incorrect options due to this issue will be retrieved, and any accounts that are found to have abused this issue will be investigated and may face restrictions, such as account login restrictions, depending on the investigation results.

Moreover, as a sign of our sincere apology to those who play UNDECEMBER according to proper and fair standards, we are planning on sending relevant compensation for this issue.

※ We will provide more information about further measures and compensation through a separate notice soon.
※ We will also take into consideration any harm that may have been caused due to Auction House trade of affected gear as part of our measures.
[b]※ Please note that any trading of gear that takes place after this notice is uploaded may be considered abuse.
※ The Auction House and Alchemy Desk Transfer category will be temporarily restricted so that we can fix the issue where ‘Legendary Grade Unique Gear’ can be transferred to ‘Normal Gear’.[/b]

We will continue to strive to ensure that we can provide a fair and honest gaming environment to all Rune Hunters.

Thank you.

notes.title: Director’s Letter Vol. 7
notes.content:
Hello, I’m Sang Kwon Han, the new director of UNDECEMBER since September.

I am sure that many of you are surprised by this sudden change in director.

Since UNDECEMBER first launched, the game has gone through much trial and error and has experienced numerous issues. We would like to sincerely thank those who have continued to play UNDECEMBER, and to sincerely apologize for the times where we have disappointed you. However, with the strong belief that UNDECEMBER has the potential to improve and become a model Korean Hack & Slash game, I have taken on the tremendous responsibility of being UNDECEMBER’s director and am now here writing my first letter to you.

In this Director’s Letter, I will briefly outline the direction in which the game’s future updates will head.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]■ Looking Back[/b]

We believe that the new Season Mode and other new modes that were suddenly introduced in the past year were all decisions that were inevitable for a Hack & Slash game like UNDECEMBER. However, understanding that these changes were not to the satisfaction of our users, we cannot help but self-reflect on the decisions that were made. Therefore, we are aiming to further improve the quality of the game so that we can fully offer the fun that comes with the Hack & Slash genre, and to establish ourselves as a game that is centered around users by ensuring that we listen to the opinions of our users closely.

First, we will prioritize stability so that we can provide a gaming environment where users can fully enjoy UNDECEMBER. We will continue to adjust the game’s balance and improve issues that were previously neglected.

Second, we will place the inherent fun that comes from combat and hunting in the Hack & Slash genre at the forefront of our aims. Due to this, please note that the development of existing or planned short-term/long-term UNDECEMBER PvP and Guild content may be delayed or discontinued.

Third, we will minimize the nerfs caused by balance changes to skills and builds. Balance changes that will not cause critical issues will be adjusted in time for the next new season.

Fourth, we will offer satisfactory compensation for issues caused by our own mistakes. Until now, there were many occasions where we were unable to provide suitable compensation to users for various issues, including bugs and convenience-related problems. From now on, we will work harder to ensure that we can compensate users for any inconvenience they experience due to issues caused by our mistakes.

[b]■ Key Improvements Planned for Oct. 12 Update[/b]

For the minor update that will be taking place soon on Oct. 12 (Thu), we are planning on taking the first step to improve the game’s deep-rooted convenience issues that have been brought to light by the game’s Origin Mode.

- Improvements to Inventory

Even though farming is a key aspect of UNDECEMBER, the lack of convenience features that allow users to easily view their items in their inventory has caused much inconvenience. To help resolve this, the inventory’s filter feature will be upgraded and the current, inconvenient Favorite feature for items will be improved so that items can be organized more easily.

- Improvements to Pet Feature

A new storage feature for Pets will be added. This will help improve the inconvenience of having to move back and forth between towns and dungeons.

- Improvements to NPC Shops and Addition of New Products

In line with the Hack & Slash genre, chance-based elements will be added to NPC Shops, which currently lack content that involves random chance. Chance-based elements will be added to the Gear Shops of the NPCs Blacksmith Croco and Blacksmith Apprentice Kiroki, which will mean that users can randomly obtain items of up to Unique and Legendary grade when they purchase gear. Moreover, NPC Brown will have new categories that sell Skill Rune Chests and Link Rune Chests, and users can obtain any Rune at random from these new chests.

We hope that these changes will help the issues that surround how ‘Special Runes’ and some Synthesis Runes, which require a relatively long time to obtain, are provided, and particularly hope to partially solve the issue where products from other Guild Shops cannot be purchased due to ‘Special Runes’. The new chance-based elements and Rune Chests will be available to purchase with ‘Gold’.

Moreover, a new Halloween event will take place with the Oct. 12 (Thu) update. This year’s Halloween event will involve high-quality rewards of epic proportions, and we will share more information about it through a notice at a later date. We hope you look forward to it!

[b]■ Season 3 Update Plan[/b]

I will now outline our plans for the Season 3 update that will take place in December. For Season 3, we will improve the quality of current UNDECEMBER content and will focus on the fun that comes with changing your builds.

Out of the 571 Unique Gear that currently exist, we will focus on rebalancing and consistently improving the ones that are not used so that they are not neglected. As Unique items will play a pivotal role in changing your skill builds in the future, we are planning on ensuring that they will help users create more strategic and diverse skill builds. In line with this, we are planning on introducing a new Unique Lacrima item that will help to resolve the restrictions that exist with the current Unique Lacrimas.

In addition, we are aiming to resolve the lack of convenience and expandability for Physical Element builds compared to other Element builds with the Season 3 update. New Physical Element Spell Skills will be added, and we are preparing to reform various existing Physical Element Skills that are not used often.

Finally, one aspect that we thought long and hard about as we planned improvements for the game’s inventory and Pet feature was the Auto Loot feature. With the addition of new content and growth elements as the game went through various changes, it has now become difficult to play the game fluidly without Pets. We have therefore concluded that the Pet feature is no longer aligned with the broader principle of providing ‘convenience’, and the paid Pet feature will therefore become free from Season 3. We hope that this will help many users enjoy the game even more.

[b]■ In Conclusion…[/b]

Since becoming UNDECEMBER’s new director, I have reflected on the issues that have surrounded the game’s management and development until now, and it is with a heavy heart that it has led my first letter to be less aspiring than desired and full of self-reflection.

To mark the change in director and as a symbol of our determination to improve the game in actuality, rather than just through words, we will be sending out ‘Director’s Special Attendance Rewards’ as gifts. We hope that these rewards will help you enjoy UNDECEMBER to its utmost until the Halloween event takes place next month.

Finally, we wish to restate our promise to invest our best efforts in ensuring that we provide you with better services as we prepare for our future updates, and we sincerely thank you again for your continuous support.

We hope that you continue to enjoy your days with UNDECEMBER, and we look forward to seeing you again with a much fuller and richer Director’s Letter next time.

Thank you.

Sang Kwon Han

notes.title: UNDECEMBER Season 2 Zodiac Pass 2
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

A new season of the Zodiac Pass,
where you can get various rewards and benefits through your journey with the new UNDECEMBER, has begun!

Enjoy your new adventures with the Zodiac Pass!
Please see below for more details. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c428697b0f0c62b9c277439fdecc1caf219c6616.png[/img]

[b]◆ Season 2 Zodiac Pass 2[/b]
  A new Zodiac Pass is beginning!

[b]■ Zodiac Pass 2 Period[/b]
 - After the Sep. 14 (Thu) maintenance – Before the Sep. 28 (Thu) maintenance (UTC+9)

[b]■ What is the Zodiac Pass?[/b]
 - By clearing Zodiac Pass missions, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
  You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
 - Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 20, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
 - Zodiac Passes will proceed according to mode within your account.
This means that Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are shared within each mode.
└ E.g.) Your play in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/5299f3777a5193dccaabede3ff557e2d522a2584.png[/img]
[b]■ Zodiac Pass Missions[/b]
 - You can check missions through the ‘Event’ icon in the game.
 - There are both Daily Missions and Season Missions.
 - Season Missions can only be cleared once during the Zodiac Pass period, and more Pass EXP can be obtained through them.
 - During the Zodiac Pass period, 5 Daily Missions will be given every day, and you can obtain Pass EXP by clearing them.
 - Daily Missions will be refreshed every day at 09:00 (UTC+9).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9af5c1a95f6bb6d435d632218471811cd42f0d8c.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Rewards[/b]
 - Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
 - Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/1c563b6dd48d4499a06dc597e50d7c523ea94f9e.png[/img]
[b]■ Premium Pass Information[/b]
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, you can receive Premium Rewards
 in addition to Normal Rewards when your Pass Level increases.
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, special benefits will be applied during the Pass period.
● Alchemy Slot +1
● Alchemy Acceleration +50%
● Stardust of Oblivion (Zodiac free reset)
※ Premium Pass benefits only apply to the mode in which you purchase the Pass.
 - 455 Diamonds are required to activate the Premium Pass.
 - Your purchased Premium Pass and its benefits will only be valid during the Zodiac Pass 1 period.

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ The Zodiac Pass period and details may be subject to change.
※ Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are applied separately for each mode (Standard/Season Mode).
※ Premium Pass rewards can only be claimed for each mode
  by purchasing the Pass separately for both Standard and Season Mode.
※ Premium Pass benefits only apply to the mode in which you purchase the Pass.
  (E.g. A Premium Pass purchased in Season Mode only applies to Season characters)
※ You can see the contents of Chest items through ‘🍳View Info’ in the item’s tooltip in the game.
※ To see chance information for chance-based items, please check this Notice on the official website.
※ Once the Zodiac Pass period ends, your level, activated benefits, and points will be reset and rewards changed.
※ If you have any activated level rewards,
  please claim them before the end of the period (before the Sep. 28 (Thu) maintenance).
※ For inquiries about the product, please contact FLOOR Support.
※ These products may be resold in a same or similar format in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Use the Zodiac Pass and add extra fun to your new journey! 

Thank you.

notes.title: Suspension of Ranking Reward Feature
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

We would first like to sincerely apologize for being unable to deliver good news 
to those waiting for the temporary suspension of the game's Ranking Reward feature to be lifted.

After announcing on [b]Sept. 8 (Fri)[/b] that the Ranking Reward feature would be temporarily suspended in order 
to resolve an underlying issue, we discovered several other issues with the feature during our maintenance.

After confirming that these identified issues could affect other elements of the game, 
we have come to the unavoidable conclusion that in order to ensure the stability of the game, 
the Ranking Reward feature must be suspended for an indefinite period of time.

Therefore, the temporary suspension of the Ranking Reward feature will be extended indefinitely 
until we announce that the suspension has been lifted through a separate notice.

You will still be able to check your Rankings in the game, but the Ranking Reward icon will be removed from the Ranking page 
after next week’s scheduled maintenance.

We are also planning on making general improvements to Rankings in time for the Season 3 update.

As an apology for this extended suspension, we have prepared the compensation below.
Please see below for more details.

[b]1. Compensation:[/b]
 - 5,000 Gemstones of Merit
 - Can claim from your mail from Sept. 21 (Thu) 14:30 - Sept. 27 (Wed) 23:59 (UTC+9)
 ※ The compensation will only be sent once per account, and the mail will be stored for 3 days (72 hours).
     ┗ You can only claim the compensation from either Standard or Season Mode.
 ※ Compensation can only be claimed by accounts that are created before the compensation mail is sent, 
and cannot be claimed by accounts that are created afterwards.

We apologize again for this extended suspension of the Ranking Reward feature, 
and we will continue to strive to ensure that we can provide better services to our users.

Thank you.

notes.title: Chaos Ticket Exchange Event
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

With the start of UNDECEMBER’s Season Mode, the Chaos Cards and Chaos Keys that you own
will be converted into Chaos Tickets, which can be exchanged for various items. 

Exchange your Chaos Tickets for the items you want at the Chaos Ticket Exchange! 

Please see below for more details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/ab05178cdbbce62a1a77aa02b0e1e6fd1f66feb8.jpg[/img]

◆ Chaos Ticket Exchange Event

■ Event Period
 - Period for automatic conversion and exchange of Chaos Tickets:
After the Aug. 31 (Thu) maintenance – Until before the Oct. 5 (Thu) maintenance
Chaos Cards, Card Chests, Memory Pieces, and Keys owned before the update will be automatically converted. 
Once the event period ends, owned Chaos Cards, Card Chests, Memory Pieces, and Keys will not be converted. 

■ Event Details
 - After the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, Chaos Dungeon items owned before the maintenance
   will be automatically converted into Chaos Tickets.
   You can give your Chaos Tickets to NPC Peddler Brown to exchange them for various items. 

■ How to Participate
1) Go visit Peddler Brown in each area’s town!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/80392e9d455e24c00ac45e2401a4db9351cba2eb.png[/img]

2) Press Exchange Item to exchange your ticket for an item of your choice!
The items that can be exchanged are limited, but the number of exchanges you can do is unlimited.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/304d34d4817020da8956be7239d51f67552d4d49.png[/img]

 ① Exchange Material: The number of Chaos Tickets you need for an item is shown here.
 ② Obtained Item: The items you can get from using your Chaos Tickets are shown here.
 ③ Exchange: Press this button to get your exchanged item sent straight to your bag. 

■ Chaos Dungeons Reset: Conversion Rates for Chaos Cards → Chaos Tickets
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/8034f42794182761469a4b2c9fa650dc78292eb1.png[/img]
- The table above shows the rates for 1 Chaos Card. 
 You will be able to check how many automatically converted Chaos Tickets you have after the Aug. 31 (Thu) update.
E.g. 1) 1 Normal Tier 1 Chaos Card = 5 Chaos Tickets (will be automatically converted)
E.g. 2) 1 Magic Tier 1 Chaos Card = 10 Chaos Tickets (will be automatically converted)

■ Chaos Dungeons Reset: Conversion Rates for Chaos Card Chests → Chaos Tickets
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/f8b789a32d5f9e24e54dc873cd7f871009f552ab.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/0d34523c5e04d8e50da34dbbbce5ee4bc7cb8b55.png[/img]

■ Chaos Dungeons Reset: Conversion Rates for Chaos Dungeon Material → Chaos Tickets
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/b122427ec0a8172869c45d5119ed499419850946.png[/img]
 - The two tables above show the rates for 1 Chaos Dungeon item.
   You will be able to check how many automatically converted Chaos Tickets you have after the Apr. 27 (Thu) update. 
E.g. 1) 1 Normal Tier 1 Chaos Card Chest = 5 Chaos Tickets (will be automatically converted)
E.g. 2) 1 Chaos Key (Madness) = 3 Chaos Tickets (will be automatically converted)

■ Chaos Ticket Exchange Information
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/710ce284deeb795f2bf5ddd30e75b5e71a899e18.png[/img]
- The table above shows the tickets needed for exchanging 1 item. 
   You will be able to see which items you can exchange your Chaos Tickets for
   through NPC Peddler Brown after the Aug. 31 (Thu) update.

■ To Note
※ Please note that once you log in after the Oct. 5 (Thu) maintenance,
    Chaos Tickets will no longer be automatically converted. 
※ You will no longer be able to exchange Chaos Tickets when the event ends after the Oct. 5 (Thu) maintenance,
    so please ensure that you use all your tickets before then. Unused tickets will disappear once the event ends.

Obtain a variety of items through this Chaos Ticket Exchange event,

notes.title: UNDECEMBER Season 2 Zodiac Pass 1
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

A new season of the Zodiac Pass,
where you can get various rewards and benefits through your journey with the new UNDECEMBER, has begun!

Enjoy your new adventures with the Zodiac Pass!
Please see below for more details. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c428697b0f0c62b9c277439fdecc1caf219c6616.png[/img]

[b]◆ Season 2 Zodiac Pass 1[/b]
  A new Zodiac Pass is beginning!

[b]■ Zodiac Pass 1 Period[/b]
 - After the Aug. 31 (Thu) maintenance – Before the Sep. 14 (Thu) maintenance (UTC+9)

[b]■ What is the Zodiac Pass?[/b]
 - By clearing Zodiac Pass missions, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
  You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
 - Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 20, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
 - Zodiac Passes will proceed according to mode within your account.
This means that Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are shared within each mode.
└ E.g.) Your play in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/82d006df07c7f94ba53566945386e817e4b6fdc3.png[/img]
[b]■ Zodiac Pass Missions[/b]
 - You can check missions through the ‘Event’ icon in the game.
 - There are both Daily Missions and Season Missions.
 - Season Missions can only be cleared once during the Zodiac Pass period, and more Pass EXP can be obtained through them.
 - During the Zodiac Pass period, 5 Daily Missions will be given every day, and you can obtain Pass EXP by clearing them.
 - Daily Missions will be refreshed every day at 09:00 (UTC+9).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9af5c1a95f6bb6d435d632218471811cd42f0d8c.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass Rewards[/b]
 - Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
 - Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass Level increases. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/520991dcbb921dc37c6ae8a0f86d9d421d8de09f.jpg[/img]

[b]■ Premium Pass Information[/b]
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, you can receive Premium Rewards
 in addition to Normal Rewards when your Pass Level increases.
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, special benefits will be applied during the Pass period.
● Alchemy Slot +1
● Alchemy Acceleration +50%
● Stardust of Oblivion (Zodiac free reset)
※ Premium Pass benefits only apply to the mode in which you purchase the Pass.
 - 455 Diamonds are required to activate the Premium Pass.
 - Your purchased Premium Pass and its benefits will only be valid during the Zodiac Pass 1 period.

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ The Zodiac Pass period and details may be subject to change.
※ Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are applied separately for each mode (Standard/Season Mode).
※ Premium Pass rewards can only be claimed for each mode
  by purchasing the Pass separately for both Standard and Season Mode.
※ Premium Pass benefits only apply to the mode in which you purchase the Pass.
  (E.g. A Premium Pass purchased in Season Mode only applies to Season characters)
※ You can see the contents of Chest items through ‘🍳View Info’ in the item’s tooltip in the game.
※ To see chance information for chance-based items, please check this Notice on the official website.
※ Once the Zodiac Pass period ends, your level, activated benefits, and points will be reset and rewards changed.
※ If you have any activated level rewards,
  please claim them before the end of the period (before the Sep. 14 (Thu) maintenance).
※ For inquiries about the product, please contact FLOOR Support.
※ These products may be resold in a same or similar format in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Use the Zodiac Pass and add extra fun to your new journey! 

Thank you.

notes.title: Advance Notice on Upcoming Changes with Aug. 31 Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

There will be various changes coming into effect with the Act 13 Hira update that is taking place on Aug. 31 (Thu).

Among these changes, we would like to inform you in advance of the content that will be reset, information regarding the end of Season 1, as well as the temporary suspension of Auction House trading that will take place in preparation for the Season 2 update.

[b]■ Temporary Suspension of Auction House[/b]

[b]◆ Auction House Suspension Measures[/b]

After the Aug. 24 (Thu) patch, you will no longer be able to register new items at the Auction House.

Items that are registered before the patch will remain registered in the Auction House for their remaining time.

On Aug. 29 (Tue), all Auction House features will be temporarily suspended.
Please collect items from failed/successful trades before this date.

After the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, the temporary suspension measures over the Auction House will be lifted.
After the Aug. 31 (Thu) maintenance, you will be able to use the Auction House as normal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]■ Content Reset[/b]

[b]◆ Chaos Dungeon Reset and Current Chaos Cards[/b]

With the Aug. 31 (Thu) Hira update, your current Chaos Compendium Score and Chaos Statue Level will be reset.

You will be able to use Saluto and Chaos Dungeons once you have cleared the new Act 13 Hira.
We hope you are excited for the new map and the various events that will be added.

Chaos Cards obtained before the update that you currently own can be used until the update takes place.

Once the Chaos Statue is reset, you will need to obtain new Chaos Cards in order to play Chaos Dungeons.

Any Chaos Cards that you do not use before the Act 13 Hira update will be converted into event items during the update.

The Chaos items that will be converted include all Chaos Cards and Chaos Chard Chests, Chaos Keys and chests that include Chaos Keys.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Black Market Reset[/b]

With the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, the Black Market’s Friendship level, item list, saved items, and Pirate’s Coins will be reset.

The Pirate's Coins and Pirate's Coin Chests that you own will be deleted with the update.
Please purchase any saved items before the update takes place. 

Your saved items on the Black Market will be deleted after the update and we will send you the ‘Deeds of Promise’ you used for the deleted items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Relic and Zodiac Reset[/b]
After the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, your Relics and Zodiacs will be reset.

Your Relic Level and EXP, and any Light of Life that you own, will be combined based on whichever values are higher out of Season/Standard mode. 

All Avatar information will be reset and Divinity Points will be given depending on your combined Relic Level.

Please log in after the update to activate your character’s Relic Avatar and reassign your Divinity Points, as well as your Zodiac Traits and Stat Points.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Constellation of Time Reset[/b]

After the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, your Constellation of Time stage and your Powerful Emotions will be reset.
Please ensure that you complete any Constellation of Time stages you are playing before the update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Zodiac Stone Emotion Engraving Reset[/b]
After the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, your Emotion Engravings on Zodiac Stones will be reset.
You can perform Emotion Engraving again through Constellation of Time after the update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Mastery Reset[/b]
After the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, your Mastery will be reset.

Your Mastery Level will be combined based on whichever level is higher out of Season/Standard mode.
Please log in after the update to reassign your reset Mastery Points.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]■ Balance and Content Adjustments[/b]

[b]◆ Changes to Disassemble Rewards due to Addition of Higher Option Tiers for Gear[/b]
After the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, higher tiers will be added to item options.

Due to this change in tier range, the disassemble results from before and after the update may be different even if the same item is disassembled.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Deletion of Challenge Mode[/b]

With the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, the new Hardcore and Origin Modes will be added and the current Challenge Mode will be deleted.

The Challenge Mode rewards, Stardust of Evolution Ⅰ and Ⅱ, will be available through Saluto Chaos sub quests.

※ There may be changes in Zodiac Specialization values due to the changed method for obtaining Stardust of Evolution. 
If your Zodiac Specialization values decrease, please obtain Stardust of Evolution through Chaos Sub Quests before using them. (Added on Aug. 31 22:20 (UTC+9))

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Changes to Descent Raid Schedule[/b]

Changes have been made to the Descent Raid schedule before the Season 2 update so that we can ensure the stability of our services.

Please see the Content Schedule page for more details.
[[url=https://ud.floor.line.games/us/bbsCmn/detail/1684840347193025906]Link to Content Schedule Page[/url]]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Crusade of Glory Ranking Rewards to Not be Sent on Sept. 4 (Mon) [/b](Added on Aug. 24 12:30 (UTC+9))
As the way in which we send Crusade of Glory Ranking Rewards will change with the Season 2 update,
please note that Crusade of Glory Ranking Rewards for matches played between Aug. 28 (Mon) – Sept. 3 (Sun) will not be sent to users on the above date.

We ask for your understanding on this matter.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Partial Rune Awakening Reset[/b] (Added on Aug. 25 13:50 (UTC+9))
After the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, some Awakened Runes will be reset due to balance changes.
If you own any Runes that will be reset, we will send you Engraving Stones and Gold according to the type of Rune you have
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]■ Information on End of Season 1[/b]

[b]◆ Season Mode Items that will Move to Standard Mode at End of Season 1[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/533e3bc7e2f8f59f5cb8d5891159a9e1b9aba1d4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Items that will Move to Temporary Storage at End of Season 1[/b]
The items in your Season Character’s Storage will be moved to Temporary Storage.
The items registered in your Season Character’s Unique/Rune Compendium will be moved to Temporary Storage.
The items in your Season Character’s Alchemy Slots will be moved to Temporary Slots.
The items in your Season Character’s Mailbox will be moved to Temporary Slots.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]※ To Note[/b]
✔ We will not be able to offer you any assistance for any Black Market items that you do not claim before the Aug. 31 (Thu) maintenance.
✔ Items moved to Temporary Storage and Temporary Slots will be deleted if not claimed before the start of Season 3.

We hope that the information above will help you avoid any inconvenience as you play the game.
We hope you are looking forward to the new update and Season 2.

Thank you.
